data.name: Гиперион X
data.description_full:
Исследуй измененный мир Гиперион и открой для себя великие перемены! Жизнь никогда не станет прежней. Небо закрыл туман, звери обрели крылья, а города отодвинулись друг от друга… Отголоски древней войны настигли нас. Девять Звезд явили знак: настало время Великого созидания и героических битв.

Живи в мутировавшем мире, сражайся с межзвездными рыцарями и верни планете былое величие. Настал твой час войти в Гиперион!

- Герои

Выбирайте класс персонажа, а вместе с ним - боевой стиль, навыки и внешность.
Мечник — лучший танк в Галактике! Выбирай, если ценишь крепких ребят.
Ронин — живой ураган на поле боя Гипериона! Выбирай, если тебе нужен головокружительный крит.
Маг — молния в центре бури Гипериона! Выбирай, если хочешь парализовать врага и усилить союзников.
Лучник — тихая (или не очень) смерть с первого выстрела! Выбирай, чтобы враг умирал раньше, чем поймет почему.

- Экипировка

Множество вариантов оружия - красиво и смертоносно! Тебя ждут артефакты и камни души, крылья, святые мощи, тайное оружие и многое другое! Всё для ослабления противника и усиления себя любимого!

- Кастомизация на любой вкус

Одежда, не только красивая, но и увеличивающая твои параметры. Аватары, чтобы тебя никогда не перепутали с кем-то другим, и рамки для них. Облачка текста, звания, и много чего ещё.

- Всё для быстрого развития

Игровые механики на любой вкус - сражения с боссами и другими игроками, подземелья, битвы на арене, крафт, задания гильдий и даже парусная романтика. Одних только боссов не перечесть. Вас ждут сражения между игроками, а также битвы гильдий и даже целых серверов! Для дропа - рулетки и захватывающие ивенты, для приключений - мрачные подземелья, для созидания - мощный крафт, для коллекционеров - уникальный архив. Точно не соскучитесь!

- Воплощения

Выбирай Воплощения на высоких уровнях, чтобы стать ещё сильнее и сочетать способности разных классов в одном персонаже! С механикой воплощений лучник сможет почувствовать себя воином или даже магом. Головокружительные сочетания откроют новые возможности!
Также будут доступны два поистине непобедимых сабкласса (а ещё эти сабклассы невероятно красивы!)

- Невероятные ивенты

Расписание на неделю будет плотным! Банкет гильдии и работа в Шахте, подъем по этажам Обелиска и безжалостная война Афритов, ежедневная Арена и гильдейская Одиссея… Всего не перечислишь, но все сражения - за добро против зла.

- Новые знакомства

Объединяйтесь в кланы, общайтесь в личных сообщениях или общих чатах, найдите новых друзей и побеждайте врагов еще успешнее! Общие завоевания сплотят вас в межсерверных битвах, хранилище снаряжения позволит обменяться вещами, а гильдейские усиления сделают вас непобедимым. И, конечно, множество разнообразных активностей гильдии не даст заскучать!

- Многоуровневая система достижений и рейтингов

Ты никогда не устанешь развиваться и стремиться к цели!

- Прекрасная графика

Невероятный мир заворожит и не отпустит, заставляя вновь и вновь возвращаться!

До встречи в Гиперионе!

From the chaotic emergency room to the steady routine of patient care wards, you will take full control of your career to become the ultimate healthcare hero.

Prepare for non-stop action as ambulances arrive with critical cases. Test your speed and efficiency under pressure! Diagnose incoming patients, check their vital signs, prioritize treatments based on urgency, and guide them safely to the correct clinic departments. In this high-stakes environment, every second counts when it comes to patient recovery.

💉 Perform Realistic Medical Procedures
Work side-by-side with expert doctors to provide top-tier medical care. Run diagnostic scans, prep rooms for surgery, administer required medications, apply protective bandages, and manage the hospital pharmacy. Master interactive mini-games that simulate real daily nursery tasks, ensuring your patients remain comfortable and happy during their stay.

📈 Upgrade and Expand Your Dream Clinic
Earn rewards for your excellent service and use your earnings to build an elite medical facility. Unlock specialized advanced units like the Intensive Care Unit (ICU), specialized surgery rooms, pediatric care wings, and modern diagnostics laboratories. Upgrade your medical equipment to accelerate treatment times and increase your overall hospital efficiency.

🎮 Main Game Features:
• Immersive Career Path: Experience a complete interactive storyline from an entry-level trainee to a world-class head nurse.
• Dynamic Time-Management: Balance multiple patient needs at once, keeping your hospital running smoothly without long wait times.
• Realistic Medical Tasks: Engage in fun, tactile mini-games covering health checks, injection simulations, and surgical assistance.

• Stunning 3D Simulation: Enjoy highly detailed visual layouts, expressive character animations, and authentic medical sound effects.

The scrubs are ready, the patients are waiting, and the ultimate healthcare adventure is officially open.

Download Nurse Life Simulator: Hospital now, step onto the clinic floor, and start saving lives today!

data.name: 서울에서 살아남기
data.description_full:
서울에서 살아남기, 당신의 수저는 안녕하십니까?

대한민국 서울, 화려한 마천루 아래 고시원에서 시작하는 당신의 이야기.
가진 것은 오직 몸뚱아리와 '흙수저'뿐이지만, 좌절할 시간은 없습니다.
지금 바로 클릭을 시작하고, 서울의 진정한 주인이 되어보세요!

🎮 게임 특징:

⚡ 압도적인 클릭의 맛 (Clicker/Idle):
간단한 터치로 원화를 채굴하세요! 폐지 줍기부터 코딩 알바, 그리고 대치동 과외까지. 더 높은 가치의 일을 통해 수익을 극대화하세요.

🏠 고시원에서 펜트하우스까지:
서울의 맵을 따라 주거 환경을 업그레이드하세요. 반지하의 습기를 뒤로하고, 한강뷰가 펼쳐지는 초호화 펜트하우스 입성이 당신의 최종 목표입니다.

🥄 5단계 수저 진화 시스템:
흙수저에서 시작해 동수저, 은수저, 금수저를 넘어 전설의 다이아수저까지! 수저가 레벨업될수록 당신의 사회적 위상과 자산 가치가 폭발적으로 상승합니다.

💸 현실 공감 부동산 & 패시브 수익:
잠자는 동안에도 돈이 들어오는 시스템을 구축하세요. 무인 카페 운영부터 강남 빌딩 매입까지, 진정한 건물주의 삶을 체험해 보세요.

🎭 매력적인 캐릭터와 스토리:
고시원 총무, 복덕방 아줌마, 성공을 시기하는 빌런들... 서울 살이의 희로애락이 담긴 흥미진진한 에피소드가 당신을 기다립니다.

🏆 도전과 성취:
다양한 미션을 완료하고 특별한 보상을 획득하세요.

지금 바로 '서울에서 살아남기'를 다운로드하고, 서울의 운명을 바꿔보세요!

data.name: Titanite: Mecha Survival Game
data.description_full:
Titanite is a post-apocalyptic Mecha survival game that fuses free-form building with competitive PvP action. In a world where rust and steel collide, you'll command powerful Mechas, carve your own path between the deadly Warzone and the absolute safety of your Base World, and forge your own rules of survival through strategy and gunfire!

♦ Battle and Tame Mechas ♦
Rogue Mechas once ruled the wilds, but now we fight back. Override their systems, seize control, and upgrade them into powerful war machines. From heavy siege units to agile fliers and resource harvesting rigs, each Mecha brings unique power to your fight for survival. Industrial types turbocharge your gathering, mobility units let you blaze across the wasteland at breakneck speed, and combat Mechas bring devastating firepower to suppress enemies and demolish fortifications. In a world shaped by steel and chaos, those who command the Mechas will rise.
♦ Two Worlds, Your Move ♦
Our revolutionary Dual-World system splits survival into two distinct realities. Drop into the Warzone where high-risk PvP means high-reward loot—take down rival survivors and steal everything they carry, but one death costs you the whole haul. Then teleport your spoils back to your Base World, a completely safe zone where you trade on the open market, upgrade your gear, and plan your next run. Risk it all for the big score or grind safe and steady? Your strategy, your survival.

♦ Explore, Build, and Defend Your Legacy ♦
Construct your base anywhere in your Base World, fortify it with walls and defensive turrets, and store your hard-earned loot. But survival isn't just about defense—team up with friends to design everything from a crude shelter to a sprawling steel fortress with automated defenses. Your base is your kingdom. Build it smart, or watch it burn.

♦ Dominate with Advanced Firearms and Tactical Combat ♦
Combat in the wild isn't just about firepower—it's about how you move, react, and strike. Combine unique firearms with tactical jetpacks for true three-dimensional warfare: hover above the chaos, dash through enemy fire, and deploy instant cover mid-fight for seamless attack and defense. Choose from a vast arsenal of weapons, each with distinct handling, attachments, and even unique abilities. Some high-tier guns come with built-in tech skills that can turn the tide of battle in an instant. With deep team tactics and high-skill mechanics, every firefight is a test of reflexes and coordination. Skill sets your ceiling. Teamwork seals the win.

data.name: 검은 공주들: 부서진 낙원
data.description_full:
거울아, 거울아.
이 세상에서 가장 미쳐버린 공주는 누구일까?

동화 마을에 다시 한번 위기가 찾아왔습니다.
저주가 내려오고, 모든 공주들이 광기에 물든 뱀의 공주로 변해버렸습니다.
어둠이 마을을 뒤덮은 지금, 과연 누가 그녀들을 구원할 수 있을까요?

【스토리】

한때 밝고 활기 넘치던 동화 마을.
하지만 죄악의 근원 메두사가 여왕을 현혹하고, 오래된 뱀의 저주를 해방하면서 모든 것이 변하기 시작했습니다.

독액은 사탕 거리 위를 기어 다니고,
알록달록했던 동화의 색채는 서서히 벗겨져 갑니다.

주민들의 눈에는 광기의 불꽃이 타오르고,
아름답던 과거는 뒤틀린 악몽으로 변해버렸습니다.

그리고 당신은 이세계에서 찾아온 용사로서,
타락한 동료들을 깨우고, 함께 진형을 짜며 위기를 돌파해야 합니다.
동화 마을을 뒤덮은 안개를 정화하고,
마법 거울 너머에서 붉은 뱀의 눈동자가 당신을 응시하는 순간,
당신은 맞서 싸울 준비가 되었나요?

지금 접속하면 2222회 뽑기 즉시 증정!
다크 판타지 동화의 새로운 이야기가 지금 시작됩니다.

【게임 특징】
▶ 다크 판타지 미학, 익숙한 동화의 반전

어두운 그림 동화를 바탕으로, 익숙한 클래식 캐릭터들을 새롭게 재해석했습니다.
뱀의 공주들은 요염함과 우아함을 동시에 지닌 독특한 비주얼로 등장하며,
각 캐릭터마다 자신만의 어두운 이야기를 품고 있습니다.

숨겨진 서사를 탐험하고, 뒤틀린 동화 세계의 진실을 밝혀보세요.

▶ 압도적인 혜택, 시원하게 뽑자

접속만 해도 2222회 뽑기 증정!
꾸준히 로그인하면 모든 캐릭터까지 획득할 수 있습니다.

풍성한 보상과 끊임없는 혜택으로,
부담 없이 뽑고, 키우고, 즐길 수 있는 초특급 보상 시스템을 경험해보세요.

▶ 간편한 방치 플레이, 부담 없는 성장

방치형 플레이를 통해 오프라인 상태에서도 자원을 획득할 수 있습니다.
언제 어디서나 가볍게 접속해, 나만의 뱀의 사도를 성장시켜보세요.

카드 전투에는 전략성과 랜덤 요소가 조화롭게 결합되어 있으며,
각 카드마다 고유한 스킬과 인연 효과를 보유하고 있습니다.
다양한 조합과 진형 배치를 통해 매번 새로운 전투의 재미를 느낄 수 있습니다.

▶ 뱀의 공주 인연 시스템, 얽혀가는 운명

모든 뱀의 공주는 자신만의 “운명의 실”을 가지고 있습니다.
캐릭터를 수집하고 육성하며, 선물을 통해 그녀들과의 인연을 깊게 만들어보세요.

인연 시스템은 스토리 해금뿐만 아니라 전투 능력 강화에도 영향을 줍니다.
더 깊이 있는 수집과 육성의 재미를 경험할 수 있습니다.

▶ 전략 조합과 실력 승부

독특한 PVP 도전 콘텐츠에서 지혜와 실력을 겨뤄보세요.
강자의 길에 오르기 위해서는 강력한 전투력뿐만 아니라,
상황에 맞는 전략적인 카드 조합이 필요합니다.

게임 속에서 당신은 뒤틀린 동화 속 캐릭터들과
기묘하고 예측할 수 없는 도전자들을 만나게 됩니다.
모든 도전은 당신의 운명을 바꿀 수 있습니다.

지금, 광기에 물든 동화 마을로 들어가
어둠에 잠긴 공주들을 구원하세요

data.description_full:

希望を失った人々が、それでも生き延びるために抗い続ける——

その旅路で、無数の物語が紡がれていく。

個性豊かな少女たちと出会い、肩を並べて戦い、絆を深めながら。
さあ、彼女たちと共に、新たな冒険へ。

──────────

◆ 放置では、この興奮は生まれない。全面リマスターのリアルタイムバトル
システムを根底から再構築。あなたの操作と、一瞬の判断が勝敗を分ける。
・スキルシステム全面刷新：無限に広がる、新次元のスキルビルド。
・QTEベースのリアルタイム戦闘：直感操作で繰り出す、ド派手な連撃。
・新規キャラクター多数参戦：個性あふれる少女たちが、あなたの部隊へ。

◆ 語られるのは、甘い日常ではなく——魂を揺さぶる物語
アーシャの真実を追う、壮大なシナリオ。
豪華声優陣によるフルボイスが、少女たちの痛切な願いを、あなたの耳へ届ける。

◆ 芸術の極致。五感を揺さぶるハイクオリティ
懐かしさを宿すアートと、最先端の描画技術が出会う。
物理演算と高度なグラフィックが、少女たちの息遣いまで描き切る。

◆ 変化し続ける戦局、無限の戦術
キャラクター固有スキルと多彩な兵装で、巨大ボスのギミックを攻略。
プレイヤー同士で力を合わせ、その戦いを勝利へ導け。

──────────


◆ 広告なしで、あの感動をもう一度。

懐かしのキャラクターとボイス、そしてより多くの報酬とともに。
そして、旅立つあなたへ——100連無料召喚を、はじまりの贈り物として。
数字で誘うのではない。心に残る一本を、あなたと。

いま、エリンで、あなたを待っている。
data.description_short: The end of destiny and a new beginning! The excitement of a classic fantasy RPG is reawakened.

data.name: Robot Smasher: Tap & Crush
data.description_full:
Zap droids, blast mechs and slay the machine swarm before it reaches your gadgets! Non-stop action where sharp reflexes decide the fate of every battle in the arena.

Hungry robots charge at the precious devices in the middle of the arena: droids march in columns, bots barge ahead, cyborgs leap from dark corners and drones dive from above. Crush every invader before it takes a bite of your tech!

20 ENEMY TYPES
Each machine has 1 to 4 lives. The tougher the monster, the bigger and slower it moves — and the harder it hits your gear. A nimble droid is tricky to catch, yet a single tap smashes it. A stubborn bot and an armored cyborg survive several blows, and at the end of every level a boss with a huge health bar arrives: killing it takes patience and your best arsenal.

Speed and size depend on the type and the number of lives: some machines dart like arrows, others crawl slowly yet bite off huge chunks of durability. Memorize their routes, set your priorities and take down the most dangerous targets first — so your supplies hold out far longer.

BRING 5 WEAPONS INTO BATTLE

Simple gear (for coins):
• Fly swatter — a classic against small fry
• Hammer — one heavy blow smashes armored shells
• Boot — slays several attackers in one stomp
• Broom — sweeps the swarm right off the screen
• Poison bait — lures and disables careless bots
• Glue — locks the fastest runners in place
• Poison gas — a toxic cloud over a whole pack of mechs
• Dynamite — blasts a crater in the crowd
• Defense box — shields your devices from greedy jaws

Advanced gear (for diamonds):
• Boosted swatter, hammer, boot and broom — each strikes 5 times in a row
• Poison syringe — kills tough monsters instantly
• Sticky tape — pins cheeky crawlers to the floor
• Electric trap — zaps every machine that steps on it
• Fire spray — burns down whole lanes
• Electric cage — a prison for the quickest drones

Coins drop from crushed enemies: spend them on simple gear or trade them for diamonds. Gems also come from completing missions — a few clicks, and the advanced arsenal is yours.

BOSS TACTICS
The boss at the end of a stage shrugs off single hits — set traps in advance, lay the bait and greet him with everything you have. Gas slows the escort, a dynamite blast clears the guards, and the boosted hammer slays the big mech.

GAME MODES
• Campaign — 20 levels of arcade mayhem where robots come in waves: every stage sends faster and bigger crowds, with a boss at the end
• Survival — an endless arcade fight against the clock: hold the line, clicking non-stop, while the swarm attacks without mercy

CHAMPIONS' LEADERBOARDS
Two tops of 20 players: best scores and levels, plus the longest survival runs. Chase records and defend the first row — every tap brings the crown closer. Become the most feared robot killer around! The competition never sleeps: champions guard their thrones daily, and one brilliant run can lift you straight to the top of the table.

WHY IT HOOKS YOU
• One-finger controls: tap — and the target is smashed to pieces
• Classic arcade and clicker in one: no pauses, no boring menus
• Juicy zap effects and explosive action on every hit
• Wave after wave, the swarms keep coming — and the rush never lets go

Every robot has a personality: droids win by numbers, bots by speed, cyborgs by armor, drones by maneuvers. Study the machines, pick the right weapon and slay your way through like a true strategist!

Think your reflexes are sharp? Smash a droid mid-run, blast a drone out of the air, crush a heavy mech with a kill combo — fast action at its purest, level after level.

Download the free arcade clicker now, beat all 20 action-packed levels, zap every boss and stop the invasion while your gadgets survive in one piece!

Ready for more action? Tap install — the arena awaits its champion, and a swarm of cyborgs is already lining up. Zap without missing, blast through every wave, slay the toughest, crush the last mech standing and stay fast to the final second!
data.description_short: Kill bots, drones & cyborgs in this fast arcade clicker. Survive every wave!

data.name: ZombieTok: The Last Stream
data.description_full:
Welcome to ZombieTok: The Last Stream!

The Apocalypse is here. Zombies have taken the streets, the Wasteland expands, and dangerous Mutants roam the dark. There are no safe zones and no real audience—because you aren't just watching a Livestream, you are the main Streamer of this doomsday show.

ZombieTok: The Last Stream is a Zombie Apocalypse-themed 3D idle RPG. As a survivor and Streamer, assemble your hunter squad, start Livestream missions, and battle zombies, Mutants, and Wasteland bosses for Survival resources.

[Apocalyptic Livestream, Survival is Content]
In this Wasteland world, every deployment is a Livestream. The audience wants thrills, the Zombies want you dead, and your job is to lead your squad to complete quests, collect gear, upgrade weapons and armor, and create your own epic moments.

[3D Zombie Wasteland, Immersive RPG Experience]
Explore Zombie-infested cities, abandoned streets, and dangerous outposts. Face ordinary zombies, powerful Mutants, and doomsday bosses. Constantly improve character stats, gear strength, and team CP to tackle higher-difficulty PvE Wasteland stages.

[AFK Rewards & Auto-battle for Easy Growth]
Don't want to grind manually? No problem. The game supports Auto-battle and AFK rewards. Even when offline, you can continue gathering resources to help you level up characters, enhance gear, and boost CP. Go Online to claim your rewards and continue your Survival journey.

[Hunter Progression, Build Your Doomsday Squad]
Train multiple characters, each with unique roles and combat abilities. Build the perfect Survival squad through leveling, gear enhancement, stat boosts, and team composition.

[Build a Zombie Farm & Collect Resources]
Catch a Zombie to work for you! Give them a job and make them work overtime to generate endless AFK income! Upgrade your farm to gather even more resources.

[Doomsday Bounties & Cross-Server PvP]
Cooperate across the server to challenge Zombie bosses, and team up on your Livestream for massive rewards. The Apocalypse isn't a solo show—true elites prove themselves on the PvP leaderboards.

[Guild, Friends & Chat Social Features]
Join a Guild, make friends, and discuss team builds, events, and combat strategies in the global Chat. Participate in events with Guild members, challenge tough enemies, and build your own Survival alliance.

[Branching Storyline, The Truth Behind the Livestream]
A complete storyline with multiple branches and endless plot twists. You'll encounter survivors, enemies, Mutants, and the secrets hidden behind the Livestream. Every choice can change your fate.

Your Livestream has started. The Chat is spamming, the Zombies are closing in, and the Wasteland awaits a new survivor legend.

Enter ZombieTok: The Last Stream now! Start your doomsday Livestream, train your hunter squad, utilize AFK Auto-battle, join a Guild, and survive to the very end in both PvE and PvP battlefields!

Contact us: zombietok.ru@hotmail.com

data.name: Chỉ Huy Tối Thượng
data.description_full:
Chỉ Huy Tối Thượng
Chỉ Huy Tối Thượng là một trò chơi chiến lược quân sự trực tuyến độc đáo. Trò chơi mới này kết hợp chiến thuật quân sự, lối chơi casual và yếu tố mô phỏng, mang đến trải nghiệm hoàn toàn miễn phí và đầy kịch tính cho người hâm mộ game chiến tranh, RTS (Chiến lược thời gian thực) và chiến đấu quân sự.

Xây dựng Căn cứ
Trải nghiệm tính chân thực của chiến tranh hiện đại bằng cách xây dựng và nâng cấp các công sự quân sự, bao gồm tháp pháo phòng không, kho nhiên liệu và nhà máy thiết giáp. Tạo nên một pháo đài thép bất khả xâm phạm với sự cân bằng hoàn hảo giữa tấn công và phòng thủ. Quản lý chuỗi tài nguyên một cách chiến lược để tối đa hóa năng lực sản xuất chiến tranh, đảm bảo căn cứ của bạn sống sót sau những đợt pháo kích dữ dội trong các trận chiến thời gian thực.

Những Đội quân Huyền thoại
Chiêu mộ các vị tướng Thế chiến II huyền thoại như Eisenhower, Patton, Rommel và Zhukov, mỗi người sở hữu kỹ năng chiến thuật độc đáo và lộ trình nâng cấp cá nhân hóa. Kết hợp nhiều đơn vị quân đội - bộ binh, xe tăng, pháo binh và không quân - để tạo thành đội quân tối thượng có khả năng thống trị chiến trường trong cả chiến dịch PvP và PvE.

Chiến lược Chiến thuật
Một chỉ huy thực thụ giành chiến thắng với tổn thất tối thiểu. Những lựa chọn của bạn - lộ trình tấn công, thứ tự triển khai đơn vị và sử dụng kỹ năng chiến thuật thời gian thực - ảnh hưởng trực tiếp đến kết quả trận chiến. Làm chủ chiến lược chiến trường, tham gia chiến đấu RTS căng thẳng và giành hết chiến thắng này đến chiến thắng khác trong cuộc chiến hành động nhịp độ nhanh.

Chiến tranh Liên minh
Bạn sẽ chọn chiến tranh hay hòa bình? Thành lập hoặc gia nhập một quân đoàn, mở rộng lãnh thổ và tham gia những trận chiến nhiều người chơi quy mô lớn toàn cầu. Phối hợp với đồng minh, nghiền nát căn cứ kẻ thù và chứng tỏ sự thống trị của bạn trong cuộc chiến chiến lược quân sự toàn cầu. Xây dựng liên minh, Đè bẹp áp bức!

Hình ảnh
Đồ họa tuyệt đẹp, được chăm chút tỉ mỉ, từ anh hùng, vũ khí cho đến phương tiện và trang bị. Mọi chi tiết đều tỏa sáng với màu sắc sống động và hiệu ứng ngoạn mục, khiến đây trở thành một trong những game chiến lược chiến tranh được thiết kế đẹp nhất thế giới.

data.description_full:

Фрейя предсказала: мир поглотит волна демонов, и спасти его может только Куб Апокалипсиса.
Ты нашёл Куб, победил демонических владык и запечатал их силу внутри.
Но в момент победы Фрейя предала тебя, ударила в спину и забрала Куб.
И в этот миг Куб начал вращаться.
Ты возродился снова — с памятью прошлой жизни, силой и жаждой мести.
С памятью прошлой жизни и жаждой мести ты вернулся к храму, где всё началось.
Теперь судьба мира в твоих руках.

Флагманская 3D dark fantasy RPG 2026 года — «Апокалипсис: Убийца Богов» уже здесь! Детализированные персонажи, кинематографичный свет, мрачные фэнтези-локации и огромный мир, захваченный демонами.

Настрой внешность героя и выбери свой путь развития. Стань мощным воином, который сметает врагов в ближнем бою, или магом, управляющим разрушительной силой. Играй так, как нравится именно тебе.

【Собери свою мифическую команду】
Во время приключения ты встретишь легендарных персонажей: Короля эльфов, Фрейю, Ареса, Афину и других героев. Призывай их в свою команду и создай армию, которая бросит вызов демонам и богам.

【Демоны наступают — сразись с боссами】
Драконы и тысячи монстров вторглись в мир. Всё живое на грани гибели. Бери союзников, побеждай мощных боссов, прокачивай героя и становись сильнейшим.

data.name: Стражи Запретной Зоны

Chiến đấu với hàng triệu người chơi từ khắp nơi trên thế giới và đánh bại những kẻ cản đường bạn! Giành lấy ngai vàng và thống trị tất cả trong trò chơi chiến lược tuyệt vời này!

Trải nghiệm cảm giác chiến tranh hồi hộp khi quân lính đụng độ trong đồ họa 3D đẹp mắt! Xem Tướng của bạn giải phóng các kỹ năng và khai thác sức mạnh thần bí!

data.name: Spark Dream Tiles
data.description_full:
✨ Spark Dream Tiles: Where Every Match Ignites a World of Wonder.​ ✨
What if you could playwith your dreams? Welcome to Spark Dream Tiles, a match-3 adventure where your imagination is the ultimate power. Each magical tile holds a sleeping spark. Your task? Match them wisely to create dazzling chain reactions, illuminating breathtaking dreamscapes and bringing a slumbering world of fantasy to vivid, sparkling life.
Awaken the Magic Within:
• The Spark of Creation:​ Every clever match you make releases bursts of brilliant light and energy. Watch as your moves paint the dream world with color, animation, and life. You’re not just solving puzzles—you’re creating art and magic with every swap.
• A Canvas of Dreams:​ Explore ethereal levels that evolve as you play. From starlit libraries to crystalline forests, each dreamscape is a blank slate waiting for your spark to bring forth its hidden beauty and wondrous secrets.
• Power-Ups Born from Imagination:​ Unleash unique abilities like the Dreamweaver’s Touch​ (cleaves a path), the Starburst Cascade​ (triggers cross-board explosions), and the Lumina Charge​ (super-charges adjacent tiles). Your strategy fuels the spectacle.
• A Journey of Luminescent Discovery:​ Progress by restoring light and wonder to forgotten corners of the dream realm. Collect glowing “Lumen” fragments and unlock new, ever-more fantastical tile sets and dream zones. The sense of discovery is constant and rewarding.
• Serene Yet Electrifying Atmosphere:​ Immerse yourself in an ambient, melodic soundtrack that swells with your successes. The gameplay is a perfect balance of thoughtful, calming strategy and moments of exhilarating, spark-filled triumph.
Spark Dream Tilesis for the dreamer, the creator, and the puzzle-lover who finds joy in makingthings beautiful. It’s a game about potential, transformation, and the simple, profound joy of making light where there was none.
👉 Download now. Ignite your first spark, and watch the dream begin.

From the first elegant swipe, you‘ll be captivated by its deep allure, sophisticated challenge, and the promise of exquisite satisfaction.

• Hypnotic Visual Seduction:​ Every element is designed to captivate. Luxurious colors, mesmerizing animations, and a polished sheen create an environment that‘s simply gorgeous to behold and touch. It feels expensive and exclusive.
• Deeply Satisfying Core Loop:​ The gameplay is engineered for maximum engagement. Each match delivers a perfect hit of tactile and visual feedback, creating a rhythm that‘s easy to start but masterfully difficult to put down. It‘s the “just one more level” feeling, perfected.
• Tempting Progression & Rewards:​ Unlock new realms of beauty and increasingly desirable tile sets. The game dangles the next exquisite reward just within reach, fueling your desire to keep playing, to see what breathtaking visual treat awaits next.

data.name: Chicken Egg Road
data.description_full:
🐥 Chicken Egg Road — the most charming and addictive logic puzzle on the farm! 🥚

The farm is in a bit of a muddle! Our colorful hens have lost their eggs, and only you can help them find the right path. Draw paths, connect the colors, and restore order to the countryside in this cozy, brain-teasing adventure.

• 🎚️ 3 Difficulty Levels: Choose your pace from Easy for a relaxing start to Hard for a true logic challenge.
• 🔲 Varied Grid Sizes: Play on boards ranging from 5x5 up to large 10x10 grids.
• 🌾 Beautiful Rustic Graphics: Enjoy a stunning farm-style aesthetic with wooden interfaces, soft grass textures, and cute animated chickens.
• 🧠 Brain-Training Fun: Improve your spatial logic and planning skills with countless unique puzzles.
• ⭐ Perfect Progress: Earn stars and track your "Perfect" 100% board completions in the Statistics screen.

🕒 Whether you have five minutes or an hour, Chicken Egg Road is the perfect way to relax and sharpen your mind.

⬇️ The farm is waiting for you. Start drawing the path today!

자소서 작성부터 자격증 취득과 면접까지!
현실과 똑같이 재현한 취업 과정을 스트레스 없이 즐겨보세요.
육성 시뮬레이션 맛집 바삭한소프트가 수험생 키우기에 이어 긴 시간 야심차게 준비했습니다!

📕 내가 선택하는 대로 멀티엔딩 ‘스토리 모드’📘
부모님의 잘못으로 빚 100억이 생겼다?
모두 포기하려던 그때, ‘천하그룹’에 대한 소문을 듣게 되는데..
늘 도와주는 스터디원들과 방해하는 세력 사이에서, 나만의 방식으로 나의 운명을 선택해보세요! 엄청난 이야기가 여러분을 기다리고 있을지도 모릅니다.

🏆 국내 최고 연봉자 타이틀을 향해 ‘취업경쟁 모드’📈
방대한 스토리 대신 그저 모든 기업이 탐내는 인재가 되는 걸 추구하는 이들을 위한 모드!
매일 바뀌는 다양한 뉴스를 살피고, 상황에 따라 나만의 전략으로 최고 연봉을 획득해야 합니다💰
그 누구보다 빠르게, 남들과는 다르게 최고의 기업에 입사해보세요! 🚀

✅ 추가로 자랑하고 싶은 우리 게임의 특징들!
1. 낮은 확률을 뚫고 자격증에 합격했을 때, 너무 기뻐서 소리를 지를 수도 있습니다!!!!!!
2. 취업경쟁모드에서는 각 회사들의 가상 직원들이 남겨놓은 회사 리뷰를 읽는 맛이 쏠쏠합니다.
3. 스토리 모드의 각 단계별로 특이한 게임 시스템들이 하나씩 숨어있습니다. 그래서 질리지가 않아요!
4. 이제 입사 1년차가 넘은 바삭한소프트 스토리 기획자의 폼이 아주 좋습니다.
5. 강이현, 신서아 등 수험생 키우기에도 등장했던 캐릭터들을 중간중간 찾아보는 재미가 있습니다.
6. 300개가 넘는 다양한 회사들의 명함을 수집하고 친구들에게 자랑할 수 있습니다.
7. 지금 이 글을 쓰는 순간에도 개발진이 자정까지 야근을 하고 있습니다🥲 늘 그렇듯 게임에 정성을 담았습니다!
8. 바삭한소프트의 개발자 박현호군의 입대 전 마지막 작품입니다. 이 게임이 출시되고 일주일이 지나면 그는 논산훈련소로 떠납니다.
9. 리뷰를 통해 이 게임의 장점을 알려주신다면 이 뒤에 더 추가하겠습니다!

data.name: Door Slammers 3 Drag Racing
data.description_full:
Door Slammers is the original drag racing series built for players who want realism, not shortcuts. Designed from the start to reflect how drag racing works, DS3 focuses on skill, precision, driving, tuning, and split second decision making rather than gimmicks or imitation.

This is drag racing the way it’s meant to be. No fake physics. No borrowed systems. Just authentic performance, precise timing and the challenge of chasing the perfect run.

Every vehicle and upgrade is purpose built for drag racing. Engines, transmission, tires, suspension, gearing, boost and nitrous all affect performance in meaningful ways. Small adjustments matter and learning how your setup works is part of the fun.

Skill Over Shortcuts. There’s no automation. Launch timing, shift points, and boost usage decide the outcome of every race. Wins aren’t given, they’re earned through practice, reflexes, and smart tuning.

Test and Tune, Bracket Racing and Heads Up – Tune your vehicle to optimum performance. Compete against other racers and see how your times stack up.

Door Slammers is designed by people who understand and respect the sport. From how cars accelerate to how upgrades interact, everything is built to make races feel intense, fair, and rewarding run after run.

Progress through the game by racing and earning upgrades or choose in app purchases if you want faster access to customization and performance options for your vehicles.

data.description_full:

Online tặng 10 nghìn lượt rút, điểm danh tặng UR/SSR: Ngày 1 tặng SR Hàn Lập, SSR Mặc Thải Hoàn và vô vàn Tiên Ngọc, ngày 2 tặng SSSR Nam Cung Uyển, ngày 7 tặng UR Hỏa Long Đồng Tử, ngoài ra còn có thể miễn phí nhận UR Thanh Nguyên Tử và SSSR Đại Diễn Thần Quân.

Vào Game Nhận Ngay Đồng Hành Mạnh
Phúc lợi nhiệm vụ chính tuyến kết hợp thưởng đăng nhập, giúp tân thủ dễ dàng vượt giai đoạn đầu và tăng trưởng nhanh chóng!

Tự do kết hợp nhiều trường phái: sát thương diện rộng, kịch độc, phản đòn. Đầu tư ít, sát thương cao, vượt ải dễ dàng!

Lập đội vượt phó bản, kết đạo lữ, nuôi dưỡng con cái, hành trình tu tiên không còn đơn độc.

data.name: 解憂小食光：萌系店員養成 & 餐廳模擬經營
data.description_full:
想擁有一間專屬的森林小店嗎？從招募獲得第一位獸耳店員開始，你將與他們一起研發菜單、自由裝潢、傾聽每位顧客藏在美食背後的故事。沒有催促與壓力，只有慢慢的忙碌、小小的成就，和那些不經意就被治癒的瞬間。在《解憂小食光》裡，展開一場悠閒自在的療癒經營之旅。

◆ 招募各族店員，養成最佳夥伴
招募不同種族的夥伴，每位店員都有獨特技能加成與能力傾向。招募店員並依據能力管理，把對的人放對位置，經營效率顯著提升。養成系統包含等級、星級、屬性、技能等多條成長線，收集店員圖鑑，解鎖人物小傳，逐步擴大商業版圖，讓小店從一人經營發展到溫暖家園。輕鬆當老闆，享受休閒又療癒的養成樂趣。

◆ 傾聽顧客故事，解鎖暖心劇情
每位上門的客人都有屬於自己的回憶與秘密。透過對話與專屬任務，幫助他們找回「記憶碎片」，解鎖豐富的故事線與人物小傳。隨著好感度逐步提升，特殊顧客會成為常客，帶來更穩定的收入。經營的不只是小店，更是人與人之間的溫暖連結。在休閒之餘，體驗沉浸式的暖心劇情。

◆ 研發多樣菜譜，親手創造美味
從榛果司康、海嶼小麵到奶油杯麵，超多創意料理等你解鎖，涵蓋飲品、烘焙、甜品、輕食等豐富品類。簡單卻有挑戰的反應類小玩法「抓時機點擊」，在指針轉盤上按順序精準投入食材，順序錯誤就失敗，解壓又療癒，讓每一道菜都充滿親手製作的成就感。

◆ 自由裝潢改造，隨心打造家園
桌椅、壁紙、地毯、擺飾…所有家具都透過隨機合成獲得，每次合成都像開盲盒一樣充滿驚喜！你可以自由規劃佈置，搭配古典雅緻、簡約時尚、浪漫童話、田園鄉村等不同主題，打造獨一無二的森系小店。從室內裝潢到花園種植收集鮮花，每個角落都由你決定。

◆ 穿搭百變風格，展現個性魅力
店員不只是幫手，還能換裝搭配當季流行服飾。甜美、幹練、華麗、簡約…各種風格隨心切換。收集限定時裝，提升店鋪魅力值，吸引更多客人上門。解鎖每一位店員的人物小傳，與店員互動培養親密度，讓每一次換裝都充滿樂趣與成就感。

【推薦給這樣的你】
喜歡療癒畫風、溫馨日常、慢節奏放鬆的你
喜歡餐廳／咖啡館／美食題材的模擬經營玩家
喜歡萌系角色、店員收集與養成、換裝搭配的你
喜歡自由裝潢佈置、打造專屬空間風格的裝修控
想在休閒裡體驗爆單忙碌感，或想衝榜找目標的你
喜歡放置掛機、離線收益、享受美食帶來幸福感的人

※遊戲內容與活動規則請以實際版本為準。

data.name: Steelborn: Tank Idle RPG

Gear up for tank battles in Tank Idle RPG, the ultimate build your tank game! Equip your warrior tank and duke it out in world of warriors duels as you explore dungeons and win big in the PVP arena.

This idle tank building game allows you to forge equipment to deck out your tank, starting from the lowly raw junk category all the way up to transcendent. Along the way you’ll be able to engage in regular battles as well as take part in dungeon raids and participate in PvP arena fights. The perfect combo of idle gameplay and focused power awaits you in Tank Idle RPG!

CUSTOMIZE YOUR TANK
Heat up your forge and churn out equipment to upgrade your tank. As you progress and consolidate your strategy, focus on which upgrades matter the most to you and help you win the most battles.

DUELS AND BATTLES
Tank Idle RPG has all manner of battles awaiting you and your tank, ranging from your standard level battles where you’ll work your forge for equipment to world of warriors duels and PvP arena fights where you can duke it out to claim valuable rewards. Plus check out the dungeons and put your tank to the ultimate test!
DANK DUNGEONS – Keep your eyes peeled for the special key to drop, as this will get you into the dungeon where, if your tank survives, you’re sure to win big and stock up on resources.

AUTO-FORGE ON
Once you reach level 3 you’ll be able to set and forget your forge, allowing you to quickly build up your arsenal and sell off the pieces that don’t interest you. Select which parameters interest you the most and then get back to your battles, knowing that your warrior tank is quietly upgrading in the background.
Come build your tank and create a custom beast that will serve you well from the dank, cramped halls of a dungeon to the wide-open floor of an arena.

Idle gameplay combined with strategy – combine the fun of watching your tank rack up equipment without having to lift a finger with the intensity of carefully crafting a winning strategy.
Fights galore – from PvP arena battles to dungeon fights and even world of warriors duels, your warrior tank will rack up the miles and kills.
Think strategy – to really win big in the arena you’ll have to do more than just max your stats, so build your tank with intention.
Customize your ride – deck your tank in the best gear and your colors to let everyone know who they’re dealing with.
Let your flag fly – strike fear into your opponents with your very own battle banner.

What are you waiting for, download Tank Idle RPG and hop into your warrior tank for the fight of your life!

Thể hiện những nước đi siêu tính toán của bạn ngay từ lúc vạch chiến lược, bố trí đội hình và tùy cơ ứng biến trong các cuộc giao tranh tự động 8 người chơi ai cũng có thể tự do tham gia. MỘT THẾ GIỚI MỚI VỚI MỖI BẢN CẬP NHẬT
Đồng Quy Giới ĐTCL là một không gian luôn biến đổi, nơi trí tưởng tượng thành hiện thực. Điều đó có nghĩa rằng mỗi bản cập nhật mới sẽ đi cùng chủ đề và cơ chế mới!
Từ học viện phép thuật, những thành phố bị quái vật khổng lồ tàn phá cho đến các lễ hội âm nhạc sôi động, luôn có một thế giới mới đầy hấp dẫn để bước vào chiến đấu.

ROLL CÙNG SỰ HỖN LOẠN
Xây dựng một đội hình trong mơ cùng với những vị tướng từ một bể tướng chung, nơi những lựa chọn táo bạo, xoay bài giây cuối, và sự tình cờ bất ngờ có thể thay đổi cục diện trận đấu. ĐƯA BẠN BÈ TỚI
Thách đấu bạn bè và đối đầu trên cả PC, Mac, và thiết bị di động. Tham gia hàng chờ cùng nhau và xem chiến lược xuất sắc (hoặc chút may mắn) của ai sẽ giúp họ vươn lên vị trí dẫn đầu.

Khoe Linh Thú yêu thích của bạn trên đấu trường, hạ gục kẻ địch một cách đầy ấn tượng với các chưởng lực cùng hiệu ứng kết liễu, và di chuyển thật phong cách giữa các thế giới qua những cổng dịch chuyển. Chơi game để mở khóa những vật phẩm mới từ Vé hoặc Vé+, hoặc mua chúng trong cửa hàng ĐTCL.

data.name: الحصن: حرب القلاع

في الحصن، ستتولى دور قائد تحالف يسعى لمواجهة قوات الإمبراطورية القديمة، وبناء مملكة قوية من الصفر. ابنِ قلاعك، درّب جنودك، وحارب إلى جانب اللاعبين الآخرين في معارك استراتيجية مليئة بالتحدي والسيطرة.

الفروسية ما زالت حية
حارب الشر، وساند الضعفاء، وابنِ الحصون لحماية شعبك. اتحد مع المتمردين والتحالفات من حولك، وخض معارك ملحمية ضد الإمبراطورية القديمة لاستعادة المجد.

ابنِ قلعة أحلامك
استمتع بنظام بناء قلاع فريد يتيح لك تطوير حصنك من الداخل والخارج، تخصيص الغرف، تدريب السكان، وتقوية دفاعاتك لتصبح قلعتك من أقوى القلاع في المملكة.

معارك استراتيجية في الوقت الحقيقي
قد جيوشك في معارك RTS واسعة النطاق، وبدّل بحرية بين التحرك والقتال. أرسل عدة فرق في الوقت نفسه، نفّذ تكتيكات مرنة، وسيطر على ساحة المعركة بقرارات سريعة تغيّر مجرى الحرب.

دفاع أبراج ممتع وسهل التحكم
اكتشف طور دفاع أبراج بسيط وممتع في نمط اللعب الفردي، يجمع بين سهولة التحكم والعمق الاستراتيجي، ويتطلب سرعة ومرونة في اتخاذ القرار.

تحالفات وحروب ملحمية
انضم إلى تحالف قوي، وتعاون مع اللاعبين من حول العالم لخوض حروب ضخمة ضد تحالفات أخرى. وسّع حدود إمبراطوريتك، سيطر على أراضٍ جديدة، واثبت أنك القائد الأجدر بالعرش.

مهمات ومكافآت يومية
أنجز المهمات اليومية، واجمع المكافآت، وطوّر جيشك وقلعتك باستمرار لتسريع نمو إمبراطوريتك والاستعداد للتحديات القادمة.

هل لديك ما يلزم لتصبح قائد القلاع؟
انضم الآن إلى الحصن - حرب القلاع، وابدأ رحلتك في عالم مليء بالحروب، التحالفات، البناء، والاستراتيجية!

data.name: Tiểu Cường 3Q
data.description_full:
Kiếp trước ta chỉ là một con kiến nhỏ bé trong thế giới loài người, vậy mà kiếp này lại chuyển sinh đến thời không Tam Quốc của côn trùng! Tuy đều là sâu bọ, nhưng kiếp này ta nhất định sẽ làm nên chuyện lớn!!!
Ta vẫn còn đang chìm đắm trong giấc mộng đẹp thì ngoài cửa bỗng vang lên tiếng: “Hài nhi Phụng Tiên cầu kiến.” Phụng Tiên? Sao nghe quen vậy… Ta còn có con rồi sao? Khoan đã… sao lại có cảm giác chẳng lành thế này...
Trong thế giới vi mô kỳ diệu này, côn trùng không còn là những sinh vật đơn giản nữa. Chúng xuyên không đến thời Tam Quốc, sở hữu trí tuệ và ngôn ngữ. Châu chấu Lưu Bị thống lĩnh “Thục Hán Châu Chấu”, bọ ngựa Tào Tháo dẫn dắt “Ngụy Bọ Ngựa”, còn bọ cánh cứng Tôn Quyền nắm giữ “Đông Ngô Bọ Cánh Cứng”. Vì hòa bình của Tam Quốc Côn Trùng, các loài sâu bọ tập hợp lại, cùng nhau bước vào hành trình phiêu lưu vừa kỳ thú vừa hài hước!
【Diễn giải vui, cải biên có chọn lọc】
Chúng tôi lấy côn trùng làm chủ thể thể hiện, kết hợp các danh tướng Tam Quốc với nhiều loài côn trùng khác nhau. Trong thiết kế, chúng tôi cố gắng giữ lại đặc trưng nguyên bản của từng loài, đồng thời hòa trộn các yếu tố nổi bật của danh tướng trong các tác phẩm giải trí như: vũ khí, tạo hình, trang phục, chiến tích nổi tiếng hay điển tích để phát triển thành kỹ năng riêng biệt.
【Tạm biệt “cày cuốc - nạp tiền”, nâng cấp nhàn rỗi】
“Chơi nhẹ nhàng” và “giảm áp lực” là mục tiêu thiết kế của trò chơi. Chúng tôi mang đến một hoặc nhiều lối chơi đơn giản nhưng đa dạng trải nghiệm. Người chơi có thể tự do khám phá theo cách mình thích. Game hỗ trợ treo máy, kể cả offline vẫn thu thập tài nguyên liên tục. Từ kỹ năng, tăng sao đến tiến cấp – hệ thống phát triển đa chiều giúp tướng côn trùng của bạn nhanh chóng tăng lực chiến, dễ dàng đánh bại kẻ địch.
【Phó bản đa dạng, vượt ải côn trùng】
Bắt côn trùng, hang động, bờ sông, hốc cây phiêu lưu… đồng thời tái hiện các trận chiến kinh điển thời Tam Quốc, mở ra một thế giới Tam Quốc Côn Trùng hoàn toàn khác biệt.
【Vận may bùng nổ – quay liên tục】
Mỗi lần chiêu mộ, chỉ cần đạt điều kiện là có thể nhận thêm một lượt miễn phí. Tích tiểu thành đại, sở hữu hàng ngàn loài côn trùng – thống nhất thế giới côn trùng không còn là giấc mơ!
【Liên minh hội tụ – tranh tài liên server】
Tạo liên minh, chiêu mộ đồng đội, cùng nhau hợp tác chiến đấu, chia sẻ kinh nghiệm và chiến thuật. So tài với người chơi từ các server khác, tận hưởng trọn vẹn niềm vui giao lưu và sự kịch tính của chiến đấu!

Fit Grid is a relaxing puzzle game that lets you think at your own pace. It works as a stress relief game after a long day, a brain training session during a commute, or a quiet mind game whenever you have a spare five minutes. It is a casual puzzle that is fun to think through.

data.name: StationeryLink
data.description_full:

Your goal is simple and satisfying: find two identical stationery tiles like pens, pencils, erasers, rulers, sharpeners, sticky notes, or markers and connect them with a line that bends no more than twice. The game starts with easy layouts, but as you progress through hundreds of levels, the board grows larger, new stationery items appear, and the puzzles become more challenging. data.name: 棋桜
data.description_full:
将棋をもっと楽しく、カジュアルに。
棋桜は、キャラクターと一緒に気軽に遊べるオンライン将棋ゲームです。
ランク対局、CPU対局、友人対局を、自分のペースで楽しめます。
戦法や囲いが決まると専用演出が発動し、一手ごとの勝負が華やかに盛り上がります。

■ 全国のプレイヤーとリアルタイム対戦

ランク対局では、全国のプレイヤーと自動マッチングで対戦できます。
カジュアル、真剣勝負、フィッシャー、ショートなど、複数のルールに対応。
自分の実力や気分に合わせて将棋を楽しめます。

■ ひとりでも、友達とも遊べる

CPU対局では、初級・中級・上級から強さを選べます。
初心者アシストのオン／オフも切り替え可能。
友人対局では、カスタムルールで仲間と対局できます。

■ 戦法・囲いが決まると専用演出が発動

戦法や囲いが成立すると、名前と専用演出が表示されます。
王手のカットイン、大駒打ちの演出、手筋エフェクトなど、勝負どころを華やかに演出。
演出は設定から簡易表示に変更できます。

■ AIアシストで、次の一手を考えやすく

「棋桜覚醒」では、AIによる候補手を確認できます。
状況に合わせた手を2つ提示し、読みの確認をサポート。
初心者の学習や、対局中の判断補助に役立ちます。

■ 初心者でも将棋を学びながら遊べる

「指し手ガイド」は、対局中の判断をサポート。
CPU対局とあわせて、自分のペースで練習できます。
また、「詰道場」では一手詰めや三手詰めをドリルのように学ぶことができます。

■ 棋譜と評価値で対局を振り返る

対局後は棋譜を再生できます。
評価値グラフや解析パネルで、対局内容を確認。
勝った対局も負けた対局も、次の一手につなげられます。

■ キャラクターや装飾品を集める

キャラクターや装飾品は、ゲーム内通貨や「縁結び」で入手できます。
使用しているキャラクターによって、対局時の立ち絵やボイスが異なります。
お気に入りのキャラクターで将棋を指そう！

■ お気に入りのキャラクターと絆を深める

対局をともにしたキャラクターとは、親密度を深められます。
贈り物で仲を深めると、ボイスなどを解放。
駒、盤面、ボイスなどを組み合わせて、自分だけの対局画面を作れます。

■ ご利用にあたって

・本作はオンライン専用です。プレイにはインターネット接続が必要です。
・一部アイテムは有料です。
・未成年の方の有料サービス利用には制限があります。
・利用規約、プライバシーポリシーに同意のうえご利用ください。

対応：Android 10以上

data.name: Forest Screwpuzzle
data.description_full:
Welcome to Forest Screwpuzzle, a calming and addictive puzzle game that combines color matching with mechanical logic! Set in a peaceful forest workshop, your task is simple yet satisfying: remove colorful screws from wooden planks, match three of the same color, and clear the board piece by piece.

How to Play

The game board features wooden planks held in place by rows of colorful screws.

Your goal is to collect three screws of the same color from the board.

Once you have three matching screws, they disappear, and the wooden plank they were holding is removed.

Keep matching and removing planks until all screws are cleared from the board.

Each level presents a new arrangement – some screws are hidden under planks, others are locked behind tricky patterns.

Plan your moves carefully. The order in which you remove screws matters – if you strip away the wrong planks too early, you might trap other screws and make the puzzle unsolvable.

Game Features

Unique Screw‑Matching Mechanic
Instead of swapping or tapping tiles, you actively select and collect screws by color. This fresh twist on match‑3 feels tactile and rewarding.

Challenging Puzzle Design
Hundreds of levels with increasing complexity. As you progress, planks overlap, screws hide beneath layers, and you'll need sharp observation and smart sequencing to succeed.

Calming Forest Atmosphere
Soothing green tones, gentle woodland sounds, and a cozy workshop setting make every session a stress‑free escape into nature.

Helpful Power‑ups

Magnet – Pulls all screws of a chosen color to the front.

Hint – Highlights the next best move.

Shuffle – Rearranges screws for a fresh perspective.

No Time Pressure
Play at your own pace. There are no timers – just pure, thoughtful puzzle solving.


Why You'll Love It

Easy to learn, but offers plenty of brain‑teasing depth.

Perfect for short breaks or longer relaxing sessions.

Beautiful hand‑drawn visuals and a gentle soundtrack.

A rewarding sense of progress – each cleared plank brings you closer to victory.

Ready to clear the forest, one screw at a time?

Download Forest Screwpuzzle today and discover the joy of methodical matching. Can you solve every puzzle and become the ultimate craftsman?

data.name: Word Bubble Associations
data.description_full:
Bubble Pop: Word Association is a sorting puzzle where you connect and sort terms, match associations, combine bubbles, and find hidden connections.

HOW TO PLAY

Find words that belong to one topic. Connect and combine the correct ones into groups, then reveal the category name. When four items are found correctly, the category disappears, and you continue searching on the field to train logic, memory, brain and the mind.

Here it is important to understand which items can be grouped by association or hidden logic. Put them together by meaning, find the correct category, and clear the entire field. This word bubble association challenge is also a bubble merge puzzle, where every correct choice helps you move forward.

WHY YOU WILL LIKE IT

• Interesting. Every level is a new puzzle with fresh groups and hidden links.
• Useful. The app helps develop memory, attention, and vocabulary.
• Smart. This is a logic challenge where you need to think, compare, and search for associations.
• Simple. Connect items, reveal categories, and complete levels.
• Free. Download, play, and train your mind at a comfortable pace.
• Calm. This calm experience is great for players who enjoy calming games and relaxed thinking.

WHO IT IS FOR

Find more complex connections, use mnemonic associations, and complete levels faster. Fans of puzzle brain games, memory games, vocabulary games, assorted puzzle games, and word chain challenges can enjoy a calm but thoughtful experience.

CONTENT AND MECHANICS

• Word sorting: sort items, search for connections, and divide them into categories.
• Word bubble association: find the common idea and connect suitable bubbles.
• Connect into groups: four items form one category.
• Word search: find items that fit each other.
• Matching and logic: use matching skills to compare ideas and choose the right group.
• Brain training: develop attention, memory, and logical thinking.

This is not a classic crossword, word search, or unscramble words. It is a puzzle for those who love to think, match, connect, and sort.

Privacy Policy: https://www.evrikagames.com/privacy-policy/

DOWNLOAD AND START PLAYING

Download Bubble Pop: Word Association for free and start playing. Find and connect items into groups, merge bubbles, and reveal categories. Train your mind with puzzle brain games, follow every word chain, and enjoy this bubble merge puzzle.

data.name: Word Fusion: Association
data.description_full:
A fresh twist on word games.

Word Fusion: Association blends word association with the satisfying rush of merge games — and clearing the board has never felt this good.

Every level hides a set of secret categories. Words arrive one at a time, and it's up to you to figure out which ones belong together. Aim, shoot, and stack matching words onto the board. Connect 4 words from the same category and POP — the bubble bursts, triggering a satisfying chain. Clear every bubble to beat the level.

It sounds simple. It isn't. As the words pile up, you'll need quick thinking, sharp instincts, and a little strategy to keep the board under control.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• A clever mix of word association and bubble merging
• Hundreds of hand-crafted levels, each with fresh categories to crack
• Thousands of words spanning food, cities, sports, animals, science and more
• One-more-level gameplay that's perfect for a quick break or a long session
• Relaxing yet challenging — train your brain without the stress
• Smart helpers like Picker and Magnet for when you get stuck
• Play anytime, anywhere — fully offline, no Wi-Fi required

HOW TO PLAY
1. Words appear at the top, one at a time
2. Aim and shoot each word onto the board
3. Group 4 words from the same category to match and pop them
4. Clear the entire board to complete the level
5. Outsmart trickier categories as you climb the levels

GREAT FOR YOUR BRAIN
Word Fusion sharpens your vocabulary, pattern recognition and quick decision-making — all while you're having fun. If you love crossword puzzles, word search, merge games or bubble shooters, this is your next obsession.

Can you keep a clear board?

Download Word Fusion: Association and discover your new favorite word game!

data.name: ArcPulse
data.description_full:

ArcPulse is a fast-paced rhythm reaction game that challenges your timing, focus, and reflexes. Each round generates a unique sequence of glowing pulse points across the screen. Your goal is simple: tap each pulse in sync with its corresponding tone as it lights up. One mistimed tap and your rhythm is broken.

Key Features

- Dynamic pulse sequences: Every round is different. The game randomly generates 3 to 7 pulse points with varying positions, intervals, and tones, ensuring no two rounds play the same.

- Progressive difficulty: The first few rounds ease you in with fixed intervals and simple patterns. As you advance, the game introduces dual-tone cross patterns, variable timing between 400ms and 900ms, and echo delay effects that test your muscle memory and prediction.

- Audio-visual feedback: Each correct tap produces a satisfying tone and a visual burst of light. Hit with perfect timing and you will hear an ascending tone while the pulse radiates with an intensified glow. Miss a beat and the screen signals your mistake with a clear visual and audio cue.

- Dark neon aesthetic: The interface features a dark background with cyan, pink, and purple neon accents. Glowing pulse points and subtle animated backgrounds create an immersive environment that keeps your focus on the rhythm.

- Personal records: Your longest streak and best flow rating are saved locally on your device. Compete against your own performance and push for higher scores with each session.

- Zero permissions required: ArcPulse does not require internet access, location, camera, microphone, or any sensitive permissions. All game data stays on your device.

How to Play

1. A sequence of pulse points appears on screen.
2. Each pulse lights up one by one with a corresponding tone.
3. Tap each pulse at the right moment to score.
4. Complete the full sequence to pass the round.
5. Two missed taps end the round. Retry and improve your streak.

ArcPulse is designed for quick 15-to-30-second sessions, making it perfect for commutes, breaks, or any moment you want to test your rhythm.

data.name: Weddings Match3
data.description_full:
Weddings Match3 – A Romantic Stacking Puzzle Game

Welcome to Weddings Match3, a charming and addictive tile‑matching game inspired by the popular stacking puzzle style. Your mission is simple: tap three identical wedding‑themed tiles to make them disappear. But be careful – tiles are stacked in layers, and you can only select tiles that are fully uncovered!

How to Play

The game is easy to learn but offers deep strategic fun:

Wedding tiles are piled on top of each other in various rows and columns.

You can only tap a tile that is not covered by any other tile.

Each time you select three matching wedding icons, they are removed from the board.

You have a limited number of slots at the bottom of the screen. When you tap a tile, it moves into one of these slots.

If the slots become full without matching three, the game ends.

Clear all tiles from the board to complete the level and advance to the next romantic challenge.

The more levels you complete, the harder they become – with more tiles, tighter layouts, and increasing strategic demands.

Game Features

Challenging Stacking System

data.name: Arototo
data.description_full:
Every arrow is boxed in, pointing straight into another one. Tap one and it only moves if its path to the edge is clear. So this isn't about speed. It's about the order. Find the one sequence that frees every arrow, and the whole jammed grid empties out.

There's always a way out. Your job is to find it.

HOW IT WORKS
• A grid packed with arrows, all blocking each other
• Tap an arrow to send it off the board, if its path is clear
• Blocked? Work out which arrow to move first. Then the next.
• Keep going until every last arrow is gone

No luck. No random boards. Every level has a clean solution, and it's on you to see it. One wrong order and you're stuck, so back up, look again, and find the way through.

WHY IT STICKS
• The quiet click of a jam coming undone
• A few minutes that turn the noise in your head down
• Pure logic, not another mindless tapper
• Easy to pick up, genuinely hard to put down

Made for people who like to think a few moves ahead. The arrows are stuck. You're the one who gets them out.

Find the order. Free every arrow.

data.name: 只今、骨休め中
data.description_full:
ブラック企業で死ぬより、 ホワイト冥界で骨になろう。
終電、残業、上司の圧――。
気づけば人生、ずっと働いてばかり。
そんな社畜ライフにサヨナラして、今度は「骨」として第二の人生を始めよう。
ここは、働きすぎ禁止のホワイト冥界。
ボーンたちとゆる〜く暮らしながら、気ままに強くなれる異世界ライフが君を待っている。

人材を使いこなし、個性豊かなボーンを集めろ
剣士、魔導士、暗殺者、魔女まで――
クセが強すぎるボーンたちが続々登場！
それぞれ異なるスキルや特性を組み合わせ、最強の冥界チームを作り上げよう。
推しボーンを育てるもよし、効率重視で編成するもよし。

骨だらけの世界で、自分だけの軍団を築け！
放置OK・自動戦闘、ボーンだけに任せろ。
忙しい？寝たい？サボりたい？
問題なし。戦うのはボーンたちの仕事だ。
フルオート戦闘＆放置報酬で、アプリを閉じている間もどんどん成長！
通勤中でも、仕事の休憩中でも、気づけば素材も経験値も山盛り。
頑張りすぎない、それが冥界流。

骨から成り上がれ、冥王へ
ただの雑魚ボーンだった君も、やがて冥界を支配する王へ――。
仲間を集め、領地を広げ、強敵を打ち倒しながら、少しずつ冥界の頂点へ近づいていく。
「骨しかない」状態から始まる、成り上がりストーリーを体験せよ！

頭脳派バトル、王の資質を見せつけろ
勝利を決めるのは、戦闘力だけじゃない。
編成、配置、スキル発動のタイミング――
君の判断ひとつで戦況は大きく変わる。
シンプル操作ながら奥深い戦略性。
ひらめきと采配で、最強の敵を打ち破れ！

Tap a pure single-color cloud to score and remove it from view. Mixed two-tone clouds look almost friendly but are traps—tap one and your run ends immediately. As new clouds keep entering from the edge, the screen fills up and every tap demands a closer look. The pace stays gentle, yet the penalty for a wrong choice keeps tension high. Cloud Catch rewards patience, attention to detail, and the ability to spot subtle color differences at a glance. With easy controls and quick sessions, it is perfect for short breaks. Pause anytime and see how many pure clouds you can catch.
data.description_short: Tap pure clouds for points. Mixed two-tone clouds end the game instantly.

data.name: Slide Hoop
data.description_full:
Slide Hoop is a cute and brain-teasing sliding puzzle game centered on ball and basket mechanics!
On each grid puzzle, the red ball and green net basket move simultaneously when you swipe up, down, left or right. Solid blue obstacle blocks stay fixed on the board and can block the basket’s movement to hold it in place.
Your core goal is to strategize sliding paths, trap the basket against obstacles, and maneuver the red ball directly inside the net basket to clear the level. Every stage sets a limited optimal move target: the fewer total slides you spend to solve the puzzle, the more stars you unlock (up to perfect 3 stars).
Core Game Features
🧩 Hundreds of unique grid layouts with increasing difficulty obstacles
🏀 Adorable cartoon-style red ball & green mesh basket visual design
⭐ Star rating system based on how few moves you use to beat levels
↩️ Convenient undo button, full level reset and pause functions
🎨 Soft mint star background with clean minimal puzzle panel UI
📶 100% offline playable, solve sliding puzzles anywhere without Wi-Fi
🧠 Relaxing logic game to train spatial planning & step-saving thinking
👆 Simple one-finger slide controls, friendly for all age groups
Think ahead to cut down your move count and collect all 3-star perfect clears! Download Slide Hoop and test your sliding puzzle logic today.

data.name: Perfect Half - Slice Puzzle
data.description_full:
You stare at the odd-shaped block on the screen. You narrow your eyes, draw a line right down the middle, and swipe. Bam. A perfect 50/50 split.

That satisfying feeling is exactly what Perfect Half - Slice Puzzle is all about. It is a casual game designed to test your eye for symmetry and see how well you can judge exact sizes.

The goal is straightforward: you need to cut in half whatever appears on your screen. You do not need complicated controls or quick reflexes. Just use your finger to divide shapes and try to get as close to a flawless 50/50 ratio as possible. Sometimes the objects are simple. Other times, they are tricky asymmetrical polygons that will turn this into a real brain teaser.

How to play:
• Look closely at the shape in front of you.
• Swipe across the screen to draw a line and slice shapes.
• Aim to create two perfectly equal parts.
• Hit the target accuracy score to move forward. If it is not quite an even cut, you simply retry the level until you get it right.

What to expect:
• Pure focus: This relaxing game has no timers, allowing you to take your time and plan your move.
• Mind training: Sharpen your spatial awareness in a logic puzzle that gently pushes your brain to think differently.
• Play anywhere: Dive into this casual puzzle during your daily commute or while winding down for the night.

Grab your device, trust your instincts, and see if you have what it takes to make the perfect split.
data.description_short: Swipe to cut in half! Divide shapes into equal parts in this slice puzzle.

data.name: GlimmerPath
data.description_full:
GlimmerPath is a spatial puzzle game that challenges your ability to plan and connect. A grid board with star points awaits your strategy. Place rotatable path blocks to create a continuous route from the starting star to all target stars.

Choose from Straight, Bend, Tee and Cross blocks. Each block can be rotated to change its connection directions. Tap an empty cell to place a block, tap a placed block to rotate it, and hold to remove it. Every placement consumes a step, and you must complete the path within the step limit.

Fifteen progressively harder levels introduce larger grids, more star points, and complex block combinations. After completing a level, unlock the next challenge. Track your best scores and compete against your own performance.

The game features a clean dark visual theme with glowing star points and semi-transparent block materials. Subtle particle animations on the loading screen and clear feedback for path validation create a focused and satisfying puzzle experience.

No internet connection required. Play anywhere, anytime.
data.description_short: Rotate and place path blocks to connect stars in this spatial puzzle game.

data.name: Outpost Guard: Zombie Siege
data.description_full:
Outpost Guard: Zombie Siege is a strategic post-apocalyptic tower defense game swarmed by endless zombie hordes. A devastating viral disaster shattered human civilization, and scattered frontier outposts on the wasteland have become mankind’s final shelters. Your vital mission is to journey through dozens of unique terrain areas, build unbreakable defense lines, and stop undead swarms from seizing these critical strongholds.

Each stage brings distinct terrain layouts that require flexible tactical thinking. You will build fortifications in sun-baked desert military outposts littered with abandoned arms, rocky canyons with narrow intercept paths, weed-choked abandoned industrial towns and misty wetlands full of hardy mutated zombies. Every landscape has unique road structures and exclusive monster types. Wide open ground allows fast rushing zombies to dash straight to your outpost core, while winding narrow corridors let you stack concentrated firepower to trap incoming monster groups efficiently.

Tower merging is the game’s signature core mechanic, separating it from regular tower defense games. Instead of wasting limited building slots on countless weak basic turrets, merge two identical towers to craft a powerful upgraded unit. Merged towers gain higher damage, longer firing range, faster attack speed and unique area skills unavailable to low-level versions. Keep fusing repeatedly to create ultimate super towers that can wipe out crowds of zombies in a single blast. Strategic merging matters greatly: blindly stacking low-level towers leaves defense loopholes, while early tower evolution helps you build solid barriers before elite zombies and giant bosses march onto the battlefield.

When massive zombie surges push your defenses to the brink of collapse, deploy limited powerful temporary boosters to reverse the battle instantly. These tactical buffs cover multiple practical effects: freeze all zombies to halt their advance, launch full-map artillery strikes, temporarily boost all towers’ damage and fire rate, and summon energy shields to shield the outpost core. Boosters are scarce rewards earned after clearing enemy waves, so save them for critical crises such as boss spawns and large-scale multi-directional rushes.

As you unlock more regions, zombie threats grow increasingly deadly. Slow ordinary walkers are joined by heavily armored tank zombies with high damage resistance, lightning-fast sprint runners, toxic mutants that erode tower durability, and towering zombie bosses with huge HP and devastating wide-range attacks. If numerous undead break through your tower formation and reach the outpost core, the outpost’s health will deplete completely and trigger defense failure.

No rigid fixed tactics limit your deployment ideas. You can arrange dense merged heavy towers for front suppression, set scattered long-range sniper turrets to wear down foes from afar, or match freezing and explosive towers to control hordes before they draw near. Make full use of each map’s terrain perks, allocate resources reasonably for tower fusion, and reserve boosters to handle sudden undead surges. Traverse every desolate wasteland zone, master tower merging skills, utilize tactical buffs flexibly, stand guard firmly at the frontier outpost, and defend mankind’s last shelters amid the brutal zombie siege.
data.description_short: Explore lands, guard outposts, merge towers and use boosters to repel zombies.

data.name: Bug Friends: Nature Match
data.description_full:
Bug Friends: Nature Match is a warm forest match-3 puzzle game centered on cute insect heroes. The bugs’ quiet woodland home is invaded by aggressive wild birds, and you will set off on a fantastic adventure to help the tiny bug warriors chase away these threatening birds and guard their lush green homeland.

The game carries unique strategic elimination gameplay combined with bug power systems. Every puzzle board is filled with vivid insect icons of various colors. You need to connect at least three identical colored symbols vertically or horizontally to charge your Bug Heroes and trigger their exclusive special perks. Ordinary three-piece matches provide basic offensive power to resist nearby birds. If you form longer chains of four or five tiles, you can unlock powerful combo effects including full-row elimination, cross blast and color conversion props. Each smooth matching combo energizes your bug companions, enabling them to release their natural special abilities to block bird attacks wave after wave.

Different from many simple elimination games without plot support, this work organically integrates forest exploration into puzzle levels, forming a complete adventure story. You will travel through dozens of thriving forest areas with delicate natural details: sunlit leaf thickets, blooming wildflower meadows, clear winding brooks, moss-covered tree trunks and hidden insect nests. Each new zone brings brand-new puzzle layouts and unique bird enemies with different interference styles. Some birds fly rapidly across the screen to cut off your matching lines, while others stay in fixed positions to continuously destroy your combos. You have to flexibly adjust your matching strategies to cope with various bird obstacles in every stage.

Every Bug Hero has distinctive characteristics and exclusive skills derived from real insect features. Hardworking ants can wipe out an entire horizontal row with one skill; lively ladybugs trigger surrounding area explosions; soft caterpillars convert random tiles into the same color for large combos; glowing fireflies light up and clear all obstacle blocks on the board. As you clear more puzzle stages and venture deeper into the woods, you will unlock more insect partners and their powerful special skills, greatly enriching your elimination tactics and bringing multi-layered strategic fun to each matching round.

data.description_full: Paddle Catch is a calm but careful selection game set against a starry sky. Moons and stars appear together on screen, refreshed in new positions every few seconds. Tap moons to score points and keep the round going. Tap stars by mistake and you lose a life—make three errors and the game is over. Moons and stars look distinct, yet the pressure builds as you hunt for the right target before the screen resets. data.name: Lightning Avoid
data.description_full: Lightning Avoid is a minimalist reflex game where color is everything. White pixel dots appear across the screen in growing numbers, and each one you tap correctly adds to your score. Black pixels look similar but mean danger—tap a single black dot and the game ends immediately. There is no second chance and no forgiveness for a careless touch. New dots keep spawning, so the playfield becomes busier and your decisions must stay sharp under pressure. The rules take seconds to learn, yet staying focused as the screen fills up is harder than it looks. Pixel Pick rewards careful observation, quick recognition, and disciplined tapping. Chase your high score, pause anytime, and prove you can tell friend from foe in a split second.

data.name: Block Slot
data.description_full: Block Slot is a steady-hand arcade challenge where precision matters more than speed. A block floats and drifts across the screen on its own, while a green safe zone marks the only place you can remain without losing. Drag the block to keep it fully inside that zone as it moves and wanders. Every moment you stay within the boundaries adds to your score, rewarding calm control rather than frantic tapping. Leave the zone even briefly and the run is over. The block resists lazy positioning, so small corrections beat wild swipes. Simple to understand yet surprisingly demanding, Zone Balance tests focus, patience, and fine motor control. Pause when needed, restart quickly, and see how long you can hold your nerve.

Passengers are waiting on a moving conveyor belt. Each one has a color — red, blue, yellow, green. Your job? Tap the bus that matches their color and send it to pick them up. Simple, right? Wait — the buses are parked all over the lot, and every bus has a direction arrow.

📦 Clear Every Bus
Your goal is to drive every bus out of the lot, each one loaded with its matching passenger(s). Just a smooth, collision‑free operation.

Can you untangle the bus jam and get everyone to their ride? Tap, match, and roll out — but don’t let them crash! 🚦🚍🔴🔵🟡🟢

ChickenFly Road Up: Escape from Area 51!
The secret base never sleeps, and the fighter jets and armored convoys show no mercy. In ChickenFly Road Up, you control a daring feathered pilot trying to cross the most heavily guarded airstrip in the world. This isn't just about luck—it’s a high-stakes test of your timing, precision, and nerves of steel. Are you brave enough to break through the military blockade?
STRATEGY & RISK
Everything depends on your touch and sense of the moment:
Split-Second Timing: Wait for the perfect gap between roaring jets and moving convoys. A second of hesitation is all it takes for the tarmac to claim its prize.
Adrenaline Multiplier: The stakes rise with every single meter you cross. The deeper you go down the airstrip, the higher your score climbs.
Push Your Luck: Bank your progress or risk it all for a new record. One mistake, and your winged pilot is sent right back to square one.
SECRET BASE REALISM
No compromises, just the raw, heavy rhythm of a military airfield:
Badass Gear: Your hero is fully equipped for action—aviator goggles, tactical belt, combat boots, and a buzzing propeller on his back!
Military Landscape: Heavy traffic unfolds against a backdrop of grey hangars, green hatches, and vehicles sporting light military camo.
Dangerous Sky & Land: Half of the ground traffic has been replaced by aircraft taking off right in front of you. Learn to "read" the runway in real-time.
WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT:
One-Handed Control: Super simple mechanics—guide your pilot to take-off completely on the go.
High-Speed Afterburner: Short, intense sessions that keep you on the edge of your seat.
Immersive Military Audio: Powerful engine roars and sirens capture the high tension of every single step.
The runway is clear. Are you ready to prove your feathered ace can outsmart all the high-tech machinery of Area 51 in ChickenFly Road Up?

data.name: Findoku: Logic Puzzle
data.description_full:
Findoku – Sudoku × Minesweeper × Cute Puppies

This game perfectly combines the logical deduction of classic Sudoku with the inferential thrill of Minesweeper. Say goodbye to boring numbers – instead, you’ll find lively, adorable dogs. Your only mission: find that unique little territory for every dog on the grid.

🎮 How to Play

Easy to learn: Dogs need their absolute personal space. They can never appear in the same row, same column, or touch each other – not even diagonally.

Minesweeper-style deduction: The game incorporates Minesweeper-like reasoning. It tests not only your placement skills but also your ability to deduce using the clues provided.

💡 Features & Mechanics

Risk & reward: Double‑tap a cell to place a dog. Guess right and enjoy a satisfying sense of accomplishment – but you only have 3 mistakes in total. Use them all and you’ll have to start over.

No blind guessing: Random guesses will quickly lead to failure. Only logical reasoning – using borders and the relationships between cells – will help you lock down safe spots and succeed.

Rich levels & difficulty: From beginner to expert, hundreds of cleverly designed logic puzzles await. Every level is carefully crafted to keep your brain sharp and engaged.

🐕 Dog Theme – Designed for Dog Lovers

Unlike traditional number Sudoku, each dog has its own unique look. Every time you complete a level, you’ll hear a cheerful “Woof!” and see a paw‑raising dog celebrating your victory!

🧠 A fresh take on classic puzzles
Break the routine – replace dull numbers with cute dog characters and make solving puzzles even more fun.

🐩 A unique dog collection
From Golden Retrievers and Corgis to Huskies, unlock and collect a wide variety of adorable dogs as you progress.

🎨 Easy on the eyes
Bright, warm colors and a friendly, intuitive interface let you enjoy the game anytime – whether you’re relaxing after noon or during a short commute.

❤️ Stress‑free brain training
A wholesome puzzle game for all ages. Exercise your mind and unwind wherever you are.

🐾 Download Findoku now and start a fun brain adventure with your clever canine companion!

data.name: 幻櫻物語:心動少女 日系少女放置戀愛手遊
data.description_full:
連接異世界的時空裂隙悄然出現，來自彼端的旅人穿過光門，踏入這片陌生的土地，與你締結契約。她們擁有古老傳承的力量，卻對眼前的異世界充滿好奇。
而你，成為了她們在此地的第一位指引者。

【· 異界來客 · 與你締結契約 ·】
遊戲中有超過百位來自異世界的角色等待與你相遇。
她們的身分各異：有出身名門的劍士、鑽研元素奧秘的學者、背負使命的神官，也有隱匿於暗影中的刺客。每一位都擁有專屬的立繪設計與技能體系。
透過關卡、活動與招募，你可以邀請她們加入隊伍，成為並肩作戰的夥伴。

【· 回合對戰 · 陣容搭配定勝負 ·】
你需要根據敵人特性，合理安排角色的站位與出手順序。前排承傷、後排輸出、治療續航、控場干擾——不同職能各司其職，方能克敵制勝。
技能之間存在連攜可能，部分角色的組合可觸發額外效果。如何搭配陣容，是你需要持續鑽研的課題。

【· 角色養成 · 穩步提升戰力 ·】
每位夥伴都可以透過戰鬥與資源投入逐步成長。
升級提升基礎屬性，突破解鎖更高等級上限，技能強化增強招式威力，裝備更換帶來直觀的戰力加成。
養成路徑清晰，資源投放節奏平穩。無需盲目追趕，每天推進一點，隊伍自會日漸強大。

【· 競技切磋 · 與其他召喚師一較高下 ·】
競技場是檢驗陣容強度的最佳場所。
匹配實力相近的對手，自動戰鬥決出勝負。你的角色練度、陣容搭配、戰術布局，將在對局中接受客觀檢驗。
勝場累積提升段位，賽季結算發放獎勵。排名前列可獲得專屬榮譽標識，普通玩家亦有穩定資源入帳。

【· 主線冒險 · 一步步揭開世界真相 ·】
遊戲主線以章節形式推進，每一章包含若干戰鬥關卡。
從最初的裂隙周邊區域，到深入異世界腹地，沿途遭遇形形色色的敵人與盟友。關卡難度循序漸進，快來開啟你的頭腦風暴！

【· 日常福利 · 細水長流的陪伴感 ·】
每日登入領取豪禮，累計簽到獲得額外饋贈。
完成日常任務累積活躍度，豐富活動產出稀有道具。
這是一款尊重你時間的遊戲。想認真鑽研可以盡興，想輕鬆收集也能自得其樂。

裂隙已開，異界的風正吹向這片大陸。
你的契約，從這一刻開始。

data.name: Pinko Drift
data.description_full:
Pinko Drift is a physics-based experience where every drop becomes a journey through a field of unpredictable possibilities. Players begin by choosing a wager and releasing a ball from the top of the board, watching as it bounces through a maze of pegs on its way toward the bottom. The path is never completely predictable, creating a constant sense of anticipation as each collision changes the ball’s direction and opens new possibilities for the final result.

At the heart of Pinko Drift is a simple yet engaging mechanic. Once released, the ball falls through rows of obstacles, ricocheting from peg to peg as gravity pulls it downward. Every impact slightly alters its trajectory, making each drop feel unique. Players have no direct control after the launch, leaving the outcome to a combination of chance and the ever-changing route through the board. This unpredictability creates excitement from the moment the ball begins its descent until it finally reaches the bottom.

The lower section of the board is divided into reward zones containing different multipliers. Some outcomes provide smaller returns, while others offer significantly larger rewards for fortunate drops. The final result depends entirely on where the ball lands, transforming every journey through the pegs into a moment of suspense. Watching the ball approach a valuable multiplier creates tension, while an unexpected bounce can suddenly change the outcome at the last moment and send it toward a completely different destination.

Pinko Drift combines straightforward mechanics with satisfying visual feedback and constant unpredictability. Successful results increase the available balance and encourage players to continue exploring different wagers and outcomes. Exceptional rewards trigger special celebrations, emphasizing particularly fortunate drops and creating memorable moments during play. Additional support appears whenever resources become limited, helping maintain the flow of the experience. Through its blend of physics-driven movement, chance-based outcomes, and anticipation-filled gameplay, Pinko Drift delivers an engaging challenge where every bounce has the potential to lead to something unexpected.

Disclaimer:
Pinko Drift is for entertainment purposes only. There is no real money involved all winnings are virtual. Play responsibly and enjoy the adventure!

data.name: Minicraft: Craftarena Block 3D
data.description_full:
Minicraft: Block Craft 3D is a professional sandbox adventure game that allows players to explore a vast block-based world filled with creativity, survival challenges, and endless possibilities. It is designed for players who enjoy crafting, building, and discovering new environments.

1. Open World Exploration
The game features a large, procedurally generated open world where every area feels unique. Players can explore forests, mountains, caves, deserts, and oceans, making each journey exciting and unpredictable.

2. Creative Building System
With its flexible block-based building system, players can construct anything they imagine. From simple houses to massive cities and detailed structures, creativity has no limits.

3. Survival Mode Challenges
In Survival mode, players must collect resources, craft tools, and defend themselves against hostile creatures. The day and night cycle increases difficulty, as enemies become more dangerous after sunset.

4. Creative Mode Freedom
Creative mode provides unlimited resources and the ability to fly. This mode is perfect for players who want to focus entirely on building and design without survival restrictions.

5. Mining and Crafting Mechanics
Mining plays a central role in the game. Players gather ores and materials to craft tools, weapons, armor, and other useful items using an easy-to-learn crafting system.

6. Enchanting and Brewing Systems
As players progress, they can unlock enchanting and potion brewing features. These systems enhance tools and equipment with special abilities, improving survival and exploration.

7. Mobs and Creatures
The world is filled with a variety of mobs, each with unique behaviors and challenges. Players must adjust their strategies to survive encounters with different creatures.

8. Biomes and Special Dimensions
Multiple biomes offer diverse landscapes, climates, and resources. Special dimensions introduce rare items, tougher enemies, and exciting new adventures.

9. Redstone Engineering
The redstone system allows players to create automated machines, traps, and mechanisms. From basic switches to advanced circuits, it adds depth and creativity to gameplay.

10. Multiplayer Experience
Multiplayer mode enables players to connect, collaborate, or compete with others. Build together, explore new areas, or engage in PvP battles for a more social gaming experience.

In essence, Minicraft: Block Craft 3D stands out through its perfect balance of creative freedom, open-world exploration, and engaging survival challenges. Supported by an active and growing community, the game continues to evolve with new possibilities. Whether you choose to play alone or team up with friends, the blocky world offers endless opportunities for fun and imagination.

data.name: IndonesianToTo
data.description_full:
"Gameplay Design
Core Gameplay:
The player clicks on two identical tiles. If the line connecting them is no more than three zigzags (i.e., two turns), the connection is successful and the tiles are removed.

The empty space after removal can be filled with surrounding tiles, or the entire tile remains unchanged.

Clearing all tiles within the specified time wins.

Game Interface Design
The main interface includes the following elements:
Game Area: A grid layout (e.g., 8x10), with an icon displayed per grid.

Top Bar:

Timer (e.g., 60-second countdown)

Score

Number of remaining hints (e.g., 3)

Back/Pause button

Bottom Bar:

Rearrange button

Hint button

Sound control

Game Logic Design
Tile Generation:
The number of tile types varies based on difficulty (6 for beginner, 8 for intermediate, and 10 for advanced).

Ensure that all tiles are matched at the beginning to prevent unsolvable puzzles.

Connection Verification:
Implement a ""path-finding algorithm"" to determine whether two tiles can be connected (with 0-2 turns).

You can use BFS (Breadth-First Search) with direction indicators.

Determine whether the two points can be ""traversed"" within the current grid state.

Removal Animation:
Use a connection effect (line drawing animation), and then gradually make the two tiles transparent.

Add special sound effects and a score-bouncing animation for each connection.

⚙️ Difficulty Design
Difficulty Grid Size Icon Type Time Limit Rearrangement
Easy 6x8 6 Types 90 Seconds ✅
Medium 8x10 8 Types 75 Seconds ✅
Hard 10x12 10 Types 60 Seconds ✅

UI/UX Style Recommendations
Keep fresh colors. Icons can use cartoon fruits, animals, or symbols.

Tile borders can have a slight shadow to enhance the three-dimensional effect.

Connection effects can be set to colored light or trails with particle effects.

未來世界，未知病毒席捲全球。神秘迷霧籠罩大地，生態崩壞，變異怪物肆虐。作為倖存者領袖，你將在絕望中建立庇護所，探索危機四伏的廢土，重建最後的希望。

招募各懷絕技的倖存者，巧妙搭配角色技能，制定專屬戰鬥方案。面對巨型喪屍首領，用智慧與勇氣突破絕境!

data.name: Color Defense
data.description_full:
A brand new defensive challenge is here. Prepare your fingers and sharpen your strategic mind in a vibrant puzzle world where quick swipes are your strongest weapons. The enemies are converging from all sides, and the central core is vulnerable. It is up to you to line up the perfect defense before it is too late.

DYNAMIC BLOCK MERGING MECHANICS
The battlefield is fluid, and your defensive towers are mobile blocks. Command your forces with intuitive swipe controls:
- Swipe to Align Defenders: Slide the blocks across the grid to position your defense units where they are needed most.
- Same Color Blocks Merge: When two blocks of the exact same color make contact, they instantly fuse together into a stronger unit.
- Higher Level Blocks: Upgrading your blocks increases their tier. Higher level blocks provide more sync and massive power boosts to stop incoming threats.

PROTECT THE CENTRAL CORE AT ALL COSTS
- 360 Degree Threats: Unlike traditional defense games, enemies attack from multiple angles. Your core sits at the center, and you must constantly rearrange your perimeter.
- Prevent Total Destruction: Keep a close eye on the health of your central core. If the barrier falls, the game is over.
- Fast Paced Tactical Swiping: Think ahead and move fast. The enemies speed up as waves progress, demanding rapid color matching and clever grid positioning.

GAME FEATURES
- A unique fusion of relaxing color match puzzles and high stakes strategy defense gameplay.
- Satisfying merge mechanics that reward smart grid management and quick tactical decisions.
- Vibrant, minimalist visual design with smooth swiping physics optimized for mobile screens.
- Multiple challenging stages with scaling difficulty to test your puzzle solving limits.

Can you handle the colorful chaos and keep the center safe? Download Color Defense today, merge your way to ultimate power, and shield the core from the endless geometric invasion!

Some moves create opportunities, while others may block future progress. Understanding these relationships is the key to mastering the game.
