data.name: Card Jam: Word Puzzle
data.description_full:
🌸 Sort It Out — Moves Matter, Categories Grow! 🌸

Flowers, fruits, animals, toys, fairies… all mixed up in one big pile. Your job? Drag every card into its matching category. Sounds easy? Wait until you see the move counter.

🎯 How It Works
Each level gives you a limited number of moves. Every time you drag a card to a category, that’s one move. You need to sort every single card before your moves run out. No pressure… right?

🧠 One Done, More Appear
Here’s the twist: as soon as you finish sorting one category, new cards of a random new type pop onto the board. Just when you thought you were done, the game says, “Oh, by the way, here come the vegetables / robots / unicorns…” You’ll have to keep adapting.

🔄 Limited Moves, Endless Thinking
You can’t just throw cards around. A wrong move wastes precious attempts. You’ll need to plan ahead: which category to finish first? Which new type might appear? Should you leave a few cards unsorted to prepare for the surprise?

🌈 More Categories, More Chaos
As you level up, the board gets more crowded. Some categories look almost identical — are those cherries or tiny red balloons? Is that a fox or a dog? Your eyes and brain will get a real workout.

🏆 Beat the Move Limit
Every level is a new puzzle. Finish within the moves, and you move on. Exceed the moves, and you’ll have to try again. No timers, just careful thinking and satisfying clicks.

Ready to become a sorting master? Grab those cards, watch those moves, and tame the ever‑growing pile! 🌸🍎🐱🧸✨

data.name: Bakery Shop: Cooking Simulator
data.description_full:
Ever wanted to run your own bakery from scratch? Supermarket Bakery Simulator puts you behind the counter, mixing dough, pulling trays from the oven, and keeping shelves stocked while a queue of hungry customers waits. It is a relaxing cooking game with just enough challenge to keep every shift interesting.

Start with a small shop and a handful of recipes. Bake bread, decorate cakes, fry donuts, pipe icing onto cookies, and plate pastries fresh for the display case. Each item has its own prep steps, so the kitchen always feels alive and varied rather than repetitive. As your bakery reputation grows, you unlock new recipes, better equipment, and shop upgrades that let you serve more customers faster.

The supermarket side of the game adds a layer most baking games skip. You are not just cooking, you are managing stock levels, rotating products, and making sure nothing goes stale before it sells. Watch your shelves, restock at the right moment, and keep the sales floor looking full and fresh. It is that satisfying store manager loop on top of the kitchen gameplay.

Serving customers is quick and readable. A customer walks in, you see what they want, you grab or prepare the item, and you hand it over. Get it right and fast and your tips grow. Let the queue pile up and satisfaction drops. The time management side scales gently as you progress, so it never tips into frustration.

Why players keep coming back:

Bakery cooking game with a real management layer, not just tapping a single button on repeat.

Dozen of food items to bake and sell, from classic bread loaves to layered cakes and glazed pastries.

Shop upgrades that visibly change your store, bigger display cases, faster ovens, and a wider product range.

Customer service gameplay that rewards speed and accuracy without punishing early mistakes too hard.

Relaxing game pacing that fits a ten-minute session or a longer play through equally well.

Colorful, detailed food visuals that make every freshly baked item look genuinely appetizing.

Simple controls that feel smooth whether you are new to simulator games or have played dozens of them.

Progress that carries meaning, each upgrade you buy and each recipe you unlock changes how your shift actually plays.

If you enjoy cooking games, time management games, bakery games, food serving games, or any kind of shop simulator, this is built for you. The mix of baking, stocking, and serving customers gives it more variety than a single-mechanic game, and the upgrade path keeps sessions feeling purposeful.

Download Supermarket Bakery Simulator, open the shop, and see how many customers you can keep happy today.

data.name: Fruit King: Drop Match Puzzle
data.description_full:
Drop cute fruits, merge matching fruits, and become the Fruit King!

Fruit King: Drop Match Puzzle is a fun and easy fruit puzzle game where you drop adorable fruit blocks, merge the same fruits, and create bigger and bigger fruits. If you enjoy fruit games, merge games, drop puzzles, block puzzles, or matching puzzle games, this cute fruit puzzle is made for you.

The rules are simple. Drop a fruit into the box, match it with the same fruit, and watch them merge into a bigger fruit. Keep merging fruits to create larger fruits, aim for the final melon, and challenge your best score. It is easy to start, but the more fruits you drop, the more strategy you need.

Fruit King combines the fun of a fruit merge puzzle, the simple control of a drop puzzle, and the satisfying challenge of a block puzzle. Every fruit drop matters. Where should you place the next fruit? Which fruits should you merge first? How can you keep enough space inside the box? Think carefully, drop smartly, and keep your fruit blocks under control.

Enjoy quick play, relaxing breaks, and high-score challenges anytime, anywhere. Simple one-hand controls make it easy to play, while cute fruits, clean design, and bright colors make every round feel fresh and satisfying.

How to Play

1. Drop fruit blocks into the box.
2. Match the same fruits to merge them.
3. Create bigger and bigger fruits.
4. Keep the fruits from overflowing.
5. Reach the final melon and aim for the highest score.

The more you merge, the bigger your fruits become. Small fruits turn into larger fruits, larger fruits lead to even bigger fruits, and the biggest fruit can give you extra score when matched. Plan your fruit drops, build merge chains, and keep the box open as long as you can.

Why You’ll Love Fruit King

- Simple and addictive fruit puzzle gameplay
- Cute fruits and colorful block puzzle design
- Fun merge puzzle mechanics
- Easy one-hand drop puzzle controls
- Satisfying matching game moments
- High-score challenge with replay value
- Great for fans of fruit games and casual puzzle games
- Relaxing, easy to learn, and fun to master

If you like watermelon-style games, fruit merge games, block puzzle games, or casual matching games, Fruit King is a great choice. Drop fruits, merge fruits, match fruits, and keep building bigger fruits until you reach the final melon.

Every round gives you a new chance to beat your best score. One smart fruit drop can open up space. One perfect merge can create a chain reaction. One careful move can save the whole game. That is what makes this fruit block puzzle simple, exciting, and addictive.

Fruit King is not just about dropping fruits randomly. To get a high score, you need to think ahead. Place small fruits carefully, keep similar fruits close together, and save space for bigger fruits. The better your strategy, the longer you can keep merging fruits.

This cute fruit puzzle game is made for players who enjoy simple rules, satisfying merges, and score-based challenges. Play for a few minutes or keep going for a new record. Fruit King is easy to enjoy in short sessions, but it also gives you plenty of reasons to try again.

Recommended for fans of fruit puzzle games, merge puzzle games, drop puzzle games, block puzzle games, matching games, cute fruit games, watermelon-style puzzle games, casual games, easy games, and relaxing puzzle games.

Đăng nhập nhận ngay 400 Vé Chiêu Mộ, điểm danh mở khóa miễn phí SSR Uesugi Erii! Tỷ lệ nổ cực cao, Quay X10 ra 3 phẩm Vàng, cùng với vô số tài nguyên tiếp tế miễn phí, quất gacha không phải rầu, dễ dàng xây dựng đội hình cực mạnh.

[Nhân Vật Kinh Điển, Lập Đội Săn Rồng]
Các nhân vật kinh điển nguyên tác như Lộ Minh Phi, Sở Tử Hàng, Erii, NoNo... toàn bộ quy tụ, tái hiện thần thái nhân vật với độ chính xác cao, kết hợp hiệu ứng động tinh tế, làm sống lại dáng vẻ nhiệt huyết trong ký ức. Tự do xây dựng đội săn rồng độc quyền, cơ chế đổi thẻ không tổn thất giúp tùy ý điều chỉnh đội hình, thích ứng mọi chiến trường.

[Treo Máy Rảnh Tay, Xong Nhanh Nhiệm Vụ]
Hệ thống hiệu suất độc quyền ""cày game nhẹ nhàng"", quét nhanh mọi nhiệm vụ ngày, rảnh rang đôi tay không cần thao tác rườm rà. Đơn giản hóa quy trình cốt lõi, tích hợp các lối chơi tần suất cao, tái định nghĩa trải nghiệm RPG thư giãn, tận dụng thời gian rảnh rỗi tăng đều Lực Chiến, thỏa sức tận hưởng niềm vui phiêu lưu và chiến thuật.

[Đấu Trường Đỉnh Cao, Tranh Hùng Học Viện]
Đấu Trường Đỉnh Cao chính thức mở cửa, các chiến binh cùng tranh tài, đoạt lấy vinh quang và phần thưởng độc quyền ""Chuyên Viên Mạnh Nhất Học Viện"". Thức tỉnh Ngôn Linh kết hợp hiệu ứng hoành tráng chuẩn nguyên tác, những khung hình bùng nổ như Hắc Nhật nở rộ, Quân Diễm ầm vang, đẩy căng sức nóng nhiệt huyết trong từng trận đấu.

[Ngoại Hình Thời Thượng, Chế Tạo Tự Do]
Đội ngũ thiết kế hàng đầu trau chuốt từng tạo hình nhân vật, kho Ngoại Hình thời thượng tự do phối đồ, tùy chỉnh toàn diện tạo hình riêng biệt. Đồ họa thế hệ mới, đặc tả chuyển động mượt mà tinh tế, tái hiện sống động các danh cảnh nguyên tác, mỗi khung hình đều là một bữa tiệc thị giác đã mắt.

[Dàn Lồng Tiếng Đỉnh Cao, Lồng Tiếng Nhật Nguyên Bản]
Lồng tiếng đa ngôn ngữ đồng hành cùng hành trình thám hiểm! Dàn diễn viên lồng tiếng đình đám tạo nên giai điệu phiêu lưu độc quyền, sẽ tiếp thêm nhiệt huyết bất tận cho chuyến đi của bạn! Mỗi đoạn nhạc đều sẽ trở thành người bạn đồng hành tuyệt vời nhất trên chặng đường phiêu lưu!"

data.name: Bend Puzzle
data.description_full:
Bend Puzzle is a calm yet brain teasing connection game. Every level hands you a tangled grid of pipes and a single glowing power source. Tap any tile to bend and rotate it, then route the energy from the source until the whole network lights up. Simple to learn, satisfying to master.

The puzzles start small and gentle, then grow into larger grids with trickier paths. Take your time and relax, or chase a perfect run by solving each board in as few moves as possible to earn three stars.

What you can do
- Tap to rotate pipes and steer the power across the board
- Earn stars based on how cleanly you solve each level
- Collect coins for every level you complete
- Spend coins in the shop on helpful power-ups

Power-ups to help you
- Hint: snaps one wrong pipe into its correct place
- Solve: locks a pipe to its final position
- Undo: takes back your recent turns
- Shuffle: resets the board so you can start fresh

data.name: Arrow quest:Lucky Reward
data.description_full:
Welcome to Arrow Quest: Lucky Reward — a gentle puzzle journey where every arrow has somewhere to go.

On each board, arrows point in different directions. Some look left, some look right, others up or down. Your task is simple but thoughtful: release each arrow the way it faces, and watch it slide off the board. No dragging. No rotating. Just pure, careful decision-making.

But there's a quiet challenge beneath the calm surface. If two arrows cross paths and touch, your run loses one chance. You begin every level with three tries. Let them collide too many times, and you'll need to start over.

This is not a game about speed. It's about seeing the board clearly before making a move. Which arrow should go first? Which one is trapped until another leaves? Step by step, the puzzle unfolds like a gentle riddle.

The visuals are soft and clean. The sounds are light and rewarding. Each solved level brings a small sense of progress — like finishing a page in a favorite book.

Whether you have one minute or one hour, Arrow Quest fits quietly into your day. No rush. No timers. Just arrows, logic, and a little bit of luck.

Can you guide every arrow home without a single mistake? Download Arrow Quest: Lucky Reward and begin your journey today.

日本代表イナズマジャパンは、大型クルーズ船『イナズマビッグフェリー』に乗り、
全世界が注目する少年サッカーの祭典
『フットボールフロンティア・インターナショナル（ＦＦＩ）』を勝ち進んでいた。
しかし、大会中に監督が突然の退任を発表する。
次の監督に指名されたのは、チームの補佐をしていた主人公・汐沢(しおさわ) 陽(よう)だった。
いきなりの監督任命に戸惑いながらも、陽は戦術分析能力を活かし、
キャプテンの円堂守や選手たちと力を合わせて、世界の頂点に立つ。

ところが、突如発生した謎の地震で意識を失い、
目覚めた時には、円堂たちの記憶から陽の存在だけが消えていた。
さらに、仲間だったエースストライカー豪炎寺修也と、ゲームメイカー鬼道有人が
帝国学園の姿で敵として現れ、冷たい視線で勝負を挑んでくるのだった。

記憶の消失、改変された関係、変わってしまった世界──
すべての真相を求め、陽は未知なる未来へと進み始める。


▼スキマ時間で手軽に遊べる！戦術重視のコマンドバトル

試合はコマンド選択のみの簡単操作！

選手を鍛え、チームに編成することで、監督としてオリジナルチームを育成。
あなたの采配が試合の勝敗を分ける、奥深い戦略性を体感しよう！

data.name: Slide Arrows Match
data.description_full:
"Slide Arrows Match" is an addictive logic puzzle game. The game screen is a grid filled with colored arrows, each pointing in a different direction. Your goal is to tap these arrows, causing them to move in the direction they point, until all arrows are off the screen. Sounds simple? Don't underestimate it—the difficulty increases as you progress!

Game Features
Basic Controls: Tap to select an arrow, and the arrow will move in the direction it points.If an arrow collides with another arrow in its forward direction, it will lose one health point. You have three health points; once you run out, you must start over.
Guidance: Each arrow in the game has an extension line indicating its forward direction.
Four different game color schemes are available to suit different gaming preferences.

Slide Rules:
Arrows can only move in the direction they point.
Only one arrow can be moved at a time.
Arrows cannot pass through other arrows.
Winning Condition: Win the level when all arrows on the board are off the screen.

How to Play
Start from the Edges: Focus on aligning arrows to the edges first—they have fewer movement options and are easier to lock onto.
You'll love it for its clean, minimalist visual design paired with vibrant arrow colors. Relaxing background music and satisfying sliding sound effects. Hundreds of progressively challenging levels. Suitable for all ages—the perfect choice for commuting, mental training, or relaxation. Ready to match? Whether you want to kill time on your commute, exercise your logic, or simply enjoy a light yet challenging puzzle game, Slide Arrows Match is for you. Research shows that playing these spatial reasoning puzzles helps improve planning skills and mental agility! Challenge yourself—how fast can you finish them all?

data.description_full:
By playing this professional brain training puzzle game, you can improve your attention, focus on details, and sustained concentration. Each level is a targeted mental exercise that helps you improve your observation skills, quick thinking, and precise layout judgment through immersive puzzle solving games.

The 60 second time limit cultivates your ability to think efficiently under mild time pressure, avoiding careless and impulsive actions.
As the difficulty increases, larger grids and more paired targets require longer sustained attention and more complex logical reasoning. The game has no fancy effects or distracting elements, creating a purely focused environment. Train your attention and improve your logical thinking in the game!

data.name: Survival Night: Room Escape
data.description_full:
The clock strikes midnight. The creeping monster is moving. Enter the haunted house in Survival Night: Room Escape, find your shelter, and lock the door fast! The scary night hunt has begun. Can you be the last survivor?

Welcome to Survival Night: Room Escape, the ultimate tactical room survival challenge! In this spooky strategy game, you are trapped inside a haunted house filled with angry ghosts and monsters. Your only chance of survival is to use your brain, manage your resources, and build an unbreakable defense before the hunter breaks down your door.

🛠️ HOW TO PLAY

+ Claim Your Room: Run fast and find an empty room before the spooky hunter catches you.
+ Sleep to Earn Gold: Lie down on your bed to generate gold. Use your resources wisely to upgrade your economy.
+ Build and Upgrade: Turn your gold into powerful defense towers, repair your door, and place deadly traps.
+ Stay Alive: Hold the line at all costs! Don't let the scary monsters breach your room defense.

🌟 KEY FEATURES

+ Tactical Tower Defense: Plan every move! Choose whether to upgrade your door for protection or upgrade your bed for more income. Strategy is key.
+ Cooperate with Allies: You are not alone! Team up with other survivors in the house. If their rooms fall, the monster grows stronger—so help each other to live!
+ Evolving Scary Monsters: Face different types of creepy bosses and ghosts that level up over time. Every wave brings a harder challenge to test your IQ.
+ Unleash Powerful Weapons: Unlock specialized turrets, electric traps, and mystic buffs to wipe out the monsters in seconds.

Do you have the wits and courage to survive the midnight hunt? Download Survival Night: Room Escape now, build your ultimate defense, and win the tactical survival battle tonight!

data.name: Vita Sort
data.description_full:
Vita Sort - Exclusive Puzzle, Strategic Categorization
Vita Sort is an exclusive Mahjong tile categorization puzzle game. We are thrilled to present this fresh title that blends classic Mahjong visual art with innovative gameplay. Featuring clear, large Mahjong tiles and a user-friendly interface compatible with phones, our goal is to provide a relaxing yet mentally engaging experience for all players, particularly focused on older adults.
How to Play Vita Sort:
Playing Vita Sort is intuitive, with its core mechanics centered around your meticulous observation, clever categorization, and strategic tapping to effectively manage the tiles and collection areas.
1. Tap to Collect: Tap any available Mahjong tile on the board, and it will first move into the temporary tray at the bottom.
2. Activate & Categorize:
- The top of the screen features 3 main category slots, displaying active Mahjong tile categories and their collection progress (e.g., "Characters 2/4").
- When a Mahjong tile enters the temporary tray, if it belongs to a category already represented in one of the main category slots, all matching tiles in the tray will automatically categorize and count towards that main slot's progress.
- If the tile belongs to a new major category and there's an empty main category slot at the top, that new category will be activated and occupy a slot.
3. Complete & Clear: Once the number of Mahjong tiles in a main category slot reaches its target requirement, that category will be fully collected and disappear from the slot, freeing up space for new categories.
4. Strategic Planning: The temporary tray has limited space. You need to plan your taps in advance, ensuring each tap effectively contributes to completing a main category. Avoid filling the tray with too many un-categorizable tiles, which could lead to a stalled game.
5. Clear the Board Challenge: Your ultimate goal is to use your wisdom to gradually clear all Mahjong tiles from the board, successfully completing each level!
Exclusive Vita Sort Game Features:
- "Tile Fusion Sort" Innovative Gameplay: Moving beyond traditional matching, we introduce the unique "Tile Fusion Sort" innovative gameplay. This is more than just simple sorting; it's a comprehensive test of your ability to quickly identify, precisely categorize, and strategically plan your moves.
- Classic Mahjong Art Style: The game features classic Mahjong tile visuals, paired with hundreds of meticulously designed board layouts, offering a familiar yet fresh visual feast.
- Large-Scale, Easy-to-Read Design: Designed with players in mind, we use large, clear, and easy-to-read Mahjong tiles and text, allowing you to say goodbye to the strain of small fonts and fully enjoy a comfortable game.
- Mentally Engaging Levels: Each level is thoughtfully designed to activate your mind, helping you enhance your categorization thinking, observation skills, concentration, and short-term memory in a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere.
- Super Combo Experience: When you cleverly strategize to trigger a continuous collection and elimination of many Mahjong tiles in one go, you'll unlock a thrilling Super Combo, gaining extraordinary game satisfaction and rewards!
- Helpful Auxiliary Tools: The game provides free and useful tools, such as the Undo function to correct mistakes, and the Shuffle tool to open up new possibilities, helping you overcome challenging situations.
- Offline Mode: Full offline support lets you immerse yourself in the fun of Vita Sort anytime, anywhere, without needing an internet connection.
Vita Sort is a meticulously crafted puzzle masterpiece designed for players who love strategic categorization and visual puzzle-solving games.
Note: This is a puzzle game in the style of Mahjong tiles, focused on categorization. It does not contain the rules of traditional Mahjong, Mahjong Solitaire, or other types of card games. The term “Mahjong” here refers solely to the visual style of the tiles.
data.description_short: Vita Sort: Mahjong tile sort puzzle. Plan, categorize, relax & train brain.

data.name: Rune Duel: Dark Match 3 RPG

Chain elemental runes, forge your hero and slay dark bosses in a dark fantasy match 3 RPG — a single-player puzzle RPG with the depth of a classic RPG.
Play fully offline — no internet required.

═══ GAMEPLAY ═══

Strategic match 3: chain runes of fire, water, lightning, nature, moon and darkness to unleash devastating magic. Chain the biggest combos to deal massive damage.

Real-time simultaneous combat: you and the enemy act at the same time. Every chain you form deals damage. Every second you lose punishes you. Reflexes, board reading and element choice decide the fight.

125 achievements with ranks: from Initiate to Eternal Legend. Each rank unlocks permanent bonuses.

═══ CONTENT ═══

4 dark worlds: The Runic Wilds, The Burning Reaches, The Sunken Tides and The Celestial Void. Each one with its atmosphere, unique enemies and final bosses.

Final Sanctum: 9 final bosses with their own personality and exclusive mechanics.

ETERNAL MODE ∞: face endless challenges. Each level gets harder. How far will you go?

Goblin's Burrow mini-game: a press-your-luck dungeon — descend deeper for richer loot, but cash out before the goblin wakes.

100% single-player and fully offline — no PvP, no leaderboards, no FOMO. Just you, your runes and the bosses, at your own pace.

⚔ Chain your runes. Conquer the Eternal. ⚔

data.name: Gridlock Sudoku
data.description_full:
Are you looking for a puzzle game with clear rules, smooth gameplay, and easy to learn? This number observation puzzle is your perfect choice! It has super simple operation, intuitive visual prompts, and zero threshold gameplay, suitable for novice players and casual game enthusiasts with puzzle experience.
The core gameplay couldn't be simpler. With just a gentle tap, you can select any blank grid cell and then choose the corresponding number from the keyboard to fill in the blank space. The game uses a scientific color discrimination system to help beginners quickly distinguish different types of numbers. All preset numbers at fixed levels are displayed in black, cannot be modified, and serve as the standard basis for solving puzzles. Meanwhile, every number you manually add will be displayed in blue.
The humanized error reminder function helps new players grow quickly. Entering an incorrect number will trigger a pale pink cell reminder, allowing you to immediately recognize the error, reconsider your judgment, and correct the mistake. There are no complex challenges, no difficult logical barriers, and no time constraints. You can freely practice your observations and numerical judgments. Start your puzzle journey with ease and enjoy the pure beginner friendly fun of brain games!
data.description_short: Enjoy the pure pleasure of mental games!

data.name: Pigment Pivot
data.description_full:
This soothing colorful bottle classification puzzle game is a perfect casual game to relax and relieve daily stress while passing leisure time! Designed for pure leisure and mental relaxation, it offers gentle and focused gameplay that can calm chaotic thoughts while exercising your brain in the easiest way possible.
Each level has a set of small bottles stacked with randomly mixed colored balls. Your goal is to rearrange these vibrant balls and purify each small bottle into a single uniform color. The game rules are very simple and easy to remember: only the top ball of each small bottle can be moved, and you can only place it on an empty small bottle or above a matching colored ball. There are no complex operations, no sudden difficulties, only stable and orderly sorting pleasure.
The uniqueness of this game lies in its zero luck design - each solvable level depends entirely on your patience and logical judgment, rather than random guessing. You can stop and think at any time, freely adjust the sorting order, and explore the best sorting rhythm. Immerse yourself in neat color classification, repair cluttered stacking combinations, and experience the peaceful and satisfying joy of turning messy small bottles into perfectly unified color series!

data.name: Gridlock Escape

Adhere to authentic puzzle rules to achieve fair and strategic gameplay. You can only slide the vehicle forward or backward along its fixed direction, and need to carefully observe and gradually plan the layout. data.name: Slippery Exit

Challenge your brain on a fixed grid filled with strategically placed vehicles that block the target's exit route. data.name: Collide Climb
data.description_full:
Master physics mechanics and strategic planning, stack, merge, and evolve spheres in this addictive puzzle game, and achieve incredible high scores. This game aims to combine realistic physical collision logic with thoughtful tactical decisions, providing easy to learn gameplay and extraordinary depth for players of all skill levels. The core loop is intuitive: carefully combine the matching units of the spheres to unlock larger and more advanced sphere types, while continuously improving your score.
Start your journey with a basic ball and steadily advance through precise merging. Every successful combination will evolve your field into a larger and more valuable variant, creating a satisfying chain of progress and score growth. When you play, the ball will pile up, bringing increasing pressure and challenges. When the stack becomes too high and threatens your progress, you can use the specialized bounce function to rearrange all the spheres on the field, reset the compact layout, and create new opportunities for further merging.
For critical and high-risk moments, a powerful bomb tool is always ready to immediately eliminate the most problematic spheres, helping you avoid scenes in the game and expand your gaming experience. It's not just a casual merge game, it also tests your ability to predict physical collisions, plan throwing positions, and reserve strategic tools for emergency situations. Each merge will increase your total score, rewarding precise location and intelligent resource management. Challenge yourself, maximize sphere evolution, defeat your personal best, and discover how far your strategic physics skills can take you!
data.description_short: Challenge yourself to achieve maximum sphere evolution.

data.name: Tier Tumble
data.description_full:
Dive into an easy to play fusion puzzle experience, suitable for players with skill levels! This physics based ball game features ultra simple one click control, intuitive mechanics, and satisfying game loops that allow you to come back in more rounds. Whether you are a complete beginner or an experienced puzzle enthusiast, you will immediately enjoy its easy-to-use yet deep gameplay.
Start each new game with a basic entry-level sphere, then delete and merge matching units to unlock larger and more evolved sphere types. The physical collision system creates dynamic and unpredictable layouts every time, ensuring that no two gameplay processes feel the same. Each successful merge immediately increases the score, providing continuous positive feedback and a strong sense of achievement.
If the spheres pile up too high, restricting your movement, click bounce and rearrange the entire field to get new opportunities for merging. When you face an imminent game risk, use a bomb to immediately clear the problematic sphere.

data.name: Trace Trek
data.description_full:
Enjoy pure, minimalist puzzle entertainment while exercising your brain and calming it down. This streamlined connectivity game emphasizes clear logic, orderly layout solutions, and stress free progression, making it a choice for daily relaxation and easy intellectual challenges.

You can replay difficult stages as needed, with standard energy consumption for each retry. The difficulty of the game steadily increases, and as you progress, it will provide larger grids and more complex pairing combinations. Play at your own pace, train your spatial thinking, and enjoy every clean, satisfying, and refreshing puzzle game experience!

data.name: Gotta Go! Find the Toilet
data.description_full:
You need to go. Right now. The bathroom is in here somewhere — but so are dead ends, fake stalls, and a urgency meter that never, ever stops filling.
GottaGo is a top-down maze escape game built around a single, desperate goal: find the bathroom before it's too late.

DAILY CHALLENGE
A fresh maze drops every single day. Each day comes with a modifier that changes how you play — do you have what it takes to top the leaderboard? Come back every day to keep your streak alive.

DAILY MODIFIERS
Every day has a twist. Run blind, race the clock, deal with double the urgency, or navigate a maze stuffed with fake bathrooms. No two days play the same.

50 CAMPAIGN LEVELS
Work through increasingly diabolical mazes. Each level is procedurally generated — the seed is fixed, but your route isn't.

FAIL IN STYLE
Didn't make it? Get a full Incident Report — a location-specific, randomly generated account of your bladder emergency. Share it with someone who deserves it.

POWER-UPS & HAZARDS
Hold Breath slows the meter. Water Bottles buy you time. But Packed House days stuff the maze with fakes — you'll need to read the layout fast.

CONTROLS YOUR WAY
Virtual joystick or drag-anywhere — switch any time in settings. Choose your character. Start running.

No account required. No ads during gameplay. Just you, a maze, and a very full bladder.
Remove ads once, play forever.

data.name: Juicy Jackpot
data.description_full:

• Expanding Grids: Feel the intensity rise as the game automatically scales the matrix from a simple 3x3 layout up to a dense 5x5 grid with every successful round.

• Dynamic Combo Multiplier: Build your momentum! Tap correct answers consecutively to activate a score multiplier and double your points.

• Dedicated Leaderboards: Keep track of your achievements with independent high-score logs for each of the three difficulty tiers.

• Polished Visual Style: Experience a premium, sleek look packed with rich gold accents, fluid matching animations, and satisfying burst effects.

🏆 The Ultimate Expert Trial:
Are you ready for the ultimate test of reflexes? In Expert Mode, the training wheels are off. You are given a strict 2-second window to make your choice. A single wrong tap or a moment of hesitation will instantly end your run!

🔥 Download Juicy Jackpot today, challenge your brain, and claim your spot at the top of the local scoreboards!

data.name: Ice Fishing
data.description_full:
Ice Fishing is a touch-only ice fishing arcade for mobile built in Flutter. The lake lives inside the phone: a single circular hole carved into a frozen surface that hides an ever deepening cold water column below it ice fishing game. Every catch starts with a slow downward swipe that physically lowers the lure, every haul ends with a single timed tap, and every session feeds a personal ledger that survives between launches ice fishing casino.
The game is built around three layered mechanics that work together instead of separately. The first is the gesture stack itself: a vertical drag pays out the line, a horizontal drag drifts the lure left and right to weave around drifting seaweed columns, and lifting the finger commits the bait to soak ice fishing live. The second is patience pressure: once the lure rests, a random bite timer ticks based on the current bait grade, and the float trembles for a brief strike window scaled by the current hook tier. Tapping inside that window lands the fish; tapping outside it costs the descent ice fish. The third is a tier ladder that grows the underwater canvas every time the player reaches a score threshold, pushing the maximum depth deeper and seeding more seaweed obstacles into the column so that paths through the water become tighter the further the run goes ice fishing games.
Two species pools rotate by depth, with shallow, mid and deep tiers each carrying their own fish names and base points, while a rare Aurora carp can replace any catch and doubles the awarded points. The Tackle Shop sells four hook grades that widen the strike window and lift the aurora chance, plus four bait grades that shorten bite delays and add a flat point bonus ice season. Coins are minted directly from successful catches so progress is self funded and there are no external currencies. The Catch Ledger keeps the last thirty entries with species, tier, depth and timestamp, summarises totals and tracks the personal best score ice fishing.

data.name: Chicken Astro Dash

A polished menu flow, animated background visuals, and a grey, red, yellow, and white visual style give the app a cohesive identity on both small and large Android screens.

Chicken Astro Dash stands out by combining an unusual chicken-versus-aliens theme with lane-based action, collectible progression, and lightweight educational content in one complete offline-friendly app.

data.name: Arrow Escape- Tap Logic Puzzle
data.description_full:
Master the Ultimate Arrow Gridlock!
Can you untangle the perfect logical knot? Welcome to Arrow Escape- Tap Logic Puzzle, a minimalist 2D puzzle game that tests your spatial logic and strategic thinking. Every block has a direction, and every move triggers a reaction. One wrong tap, and the entire grid becomes locked!

Look closely, find the hidden exit, and clear the path to escape!

💡 HOW TO PLAY

Tap to Move: Tap an arrow block to make it slide along its orthogonal path on the grid.

Respect the Order: Blocks will block each other! You must find the exact sequence of taps to release them safely.

Find the Escape: Only one arrow can break free first. Find the key that unlocks the chain reaction!

No Intersections: Every track is a flat 2D lane. No overlapping, no crossing — just pure geometric satisfaction.

🌟 GAME FEATURES

Pure Logical Chaos: Simple rules, but mind-bending gridlocks. A perfect brain workout!

Satisfyingly Crisp UI: Clean, high-contrast minimalist vector design with sharp visuals.

Zero Pressure, Pure Zen: No timers, no rush — just you against the interlocking maze.

Hundreds of Smart Levels: From small 4-arrow grids to massive, industrial-level traffic jams.

Will you get trapped in the loop or find the ultimate escape path? Download now and test your IQ!

data.name: 凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊
data.description_full:
凹嗚...嗚...嗚...
嘘.....小鎮的迷霧中，誰在說謊？

《凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊》是一款燒腦沉浸式推理解謎遊戲，你將化身偵探警長，踏入迷霧籠罩的謊言小鎮。這裡的每個居民都戴著面具，每段對話都可能暗藏玄機，而你，要靠著邏輯與細心，揪出藏在其中的真相。

-遊戲特色-
【與角色對話，在字裡行間捕捉線索】
眾多NPC各有獨立故事與行為邏輯，談話中的閃爍其詞、細節的偏差，都可能成為揭穿偽裝的關鍵線索。點擊角色就能標記「好人」或「狼人」，標對就能解鎖新提示，全程沒有複雜操作，新手也能輕輕鬆鬆上手。

【邏輯為刃，識破偽裝者】
狼人潛伏在好人之中，用言語編織騙局。遊戲以邏輯排除法為核心，透過交叉驗證線索、串聯關鍵信息，靠著嚴謹推理，就能撕開謊言，讓真相浮出水面。

【多重謎題，每一步都決定結局】
從對話選擇到線索拼合，每個決策都會影響調查方向。多重關卡逐級升級，每局2-5分鐘就能完成，純文字推理燒腦又解压，適合碎片時間玩，揪出所有狼人，才能驅散迷霧，守護小鎮。

《凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊》——真相，從來不只一面。
挑戰你的推理極限，在真話與謊言之間，做出最終審判，一起走進這場充滿玄機的文字迷宮吧。

data.name: Ivy Whirl
data.description_full:
Ivy Whirl is a one-thumb arcade game built around a single beautiful idea. A living vine of leaves orbits a glowing hub at the center of your screen. Petals, coins and gems drift in from every edge while sharp thorns try to pierce the hub. Your job is simple to describe and endlessly satisfying to play. Hold the left side of the screen and the vine spins one way. Hold the right side and it spins the other. Let go and the vine winds down gently. You guide the leaves to sweep up the good things and stand the leaves between the hub and anything dangerous.

The longer you survive the faster the garden grows. Thorns arrive more often, items come in from new angles and the vine has to keep pace. Catching a blue power capsule unleashes one of five effects. A dewdrop shield wraps the hub for a few seconds. A magnet pulls coins and blooms toward you. Slow time lets you breathe. A bloom bomb clears every thorn on screen at once. Double score rewards careful play with twice the points for a glorious window.

Coins earned in your runs carry over between sessions and can be spent in the shop on starting boosters. Equip the Fourth Leaf to add a permanent extra leaf to your vine. Equip the Golden Vein and the first stretch of every run pays double. The Slow Bloom booster lets you ease into a run in slow motion. The Dewdrop Shield begins each game with the hub already protected. Mix and match to suit your mood.

Every screen is tuned for a calm, immersive feel. The status bar stays out of the way so the garden fills your display. The pause and home buttons are large and friendly, so you can step away at any moment without losing your run. Best scores, coins and boosters are saved automatically, so you can return whenever a quiet moment finds you.

data.name: Đạo Sĩ Bắt Trương Phi
data.description_full:
Đạo Sĩ Bắt Trương Phi: Vua Bùa Chú #1 Việt Nam

Một cõi giới ngập tràn tà khí dần hé mở, nơi quỷ thần lẩn khuất trong từng khoảng không và những pháp trận bùng sáng giữa màn sương đặc quánh. Bạn nhập vai đạo sĩ bước đi trên lằn ranh âm - dương, họa phù chú, dựng đàn tế, trấn phong những linh hồn cuồng loạn đang thức tỉnh. Từ ánh linh hỏa bốc lên nơi pháp đàn đến khoảnh khắc phong ấn nghẹt thở, mọi trải nghiệm đều phủ màu ma mị và căng thẳng tột độ. Ở đó, bạn nắm giữ quyền năng thao túng âm dương, khắc chế tà lực và xoay chuyển thế trận bằng chính đạo thuật của mình trong một thế giới quỷ thần đầy sống động.

- Húp 2000+ lượt miễn phí - Vẽ bùa mỏi tay, Tướng 6 sao về ngay!
Nhà phát hành dành tặng người chơi hơn 2000 lượt quay tướng hoàn toàn miễn phí như một lời chào sân đầy thành ý. Ngay khi bước vào thế giới tà khí, bạn đã có thể khai đàn, vẽ bùa và triệu hồi liên tục mà không cần đắn đo tài nguyên. Hàng nghìn cơ hội mở phong ấn, săn tìm Tướng 6 sao đang chờ đón, giúp hành trình trấn áp quỷ thần khởi đầu thuận lợi và bùng nổ ngay từ những phút đầu tiên.

- 6 loại trận đồ - 9 ô chiến thuật - 69 kiểu chơi
Sở hữu 6 loại trận đồ biến hóa, kết hợp cùng 9 ô chiến thuật linh hoạt, người chơi có thể tự do sáng tạo đến 69 kiểu vận hành đội hình khác nhau. Mỗi cách sắp xếp là một thế trận riêng với quy luật khắc chế, mỗi sự thay đổi là một bước xoay chuyển cục diện - nơi tư duy chiến thuật quyết định thắng bại, không chỉ sức mạnh đơn thuần.

- Chưa vào game – Chưa biết thế nào là mãn nhãn.
Đồ họa quỷ thần được khắc họa đầy ám ảnh và choáng ngợp, từ pháp trận rực linh hỏa đến những thực thể hắc hóa phủ đầy tà khí. Mỗi khung hình đều dày đặc hiệu ứng, ánh sáng và chuyển động sống động, tạo nên cảm giác như đang bước vào một thế giới ma mị u ám thực thụ. Chưa đặt chân vào game - chưa thể cảm nhận hết thế nào là mãn nhãn.

- Thí luyện vô hạn tầng - Sai hệ dừng bước - Đúng hệ lên đỉnh.
Leo Tháp Ngũ Hệ Vô Tận là hành trình thí luyện không hồi kết giữa màn sương tà khí dày đặc. Mỗi tầng tháp là một thử thách khắc nghiệt của ngũ hành tương khắc - chọn sai hệ, lập tức dừng bước; chọn đúng hệ, phá ấn mà tiến lên đỉnh cao. Trong không gian u ám và ma lực bủa vây, chỉ những đạo sĩ am hiểu thiên đạo mới đủ sức bước tiếp qua vô hạn tầng tháp.

- Game "chiều" đạo sĩ nhất: Chơi mỗi ngày - tặng ngay VIP 6
Giữa thế giới tà khí u ám, đạo sĩ không đơn độc trên hành trình trấn ấn quỷ thần. Phúc lợi dày đặc trải dài theo từng cấp độ, đặc biệt tặng miễn phí VIP 6 chỉ cần chăm chỉ đăng nhập mỗi ngày. Không cần hiến tế tài nguyên, không cần đổi chác vận may - càng tu luyện, càng được ưu đãi, để pháp lực thăng hoa và quyền năng ngày một lớn mạnh.

data.name: Last Kingdom
data.description_full:
Your kingdom has been destroyed, and as its exiled prince, you are forced to flee to a strange new continent.

But the place where you begin again is no great city. It is a ruined village—broken, deserted, and barely standing. There is no army waiting for you, no loyal court, no royal power left to command. Only ruins... and a final chance to reclaim what was lost.

From this shattered village, you will rebuild your power from the ground up. Recruit powerful heroes from across the realm and lead them into battle. Then, by a twist of fate, you discover an ancient dragon egg. Raise it, hatch it, and gain a mighty dragon that will become your fiercest ally in war.

From village to town, from town to castle, you will expand step by step across this vast medieval world. March against enemies, seize territory, and prepare for the day you can strike back at the force that destroyed your kingdom.

Here, alliances shift as quickly as battle lines. You may face other Lords in open war, or join forces with them against greater threats. To survive, you must train troops, strengthen your heroes, and master the power of your dragon.

As your influence spreads across this foreign land, you will build mighty guilds, wage large-scale wars, and fight not only to restore your lost kingdom’s glory, but to claim the crown as the true ruler of the continent.

[Game Features]

[Number Gates, Instant Power]
Swipe to choose the right gate and boost your power in an instant. Break through enemy lines, overwhelm your foes, and enjoy fast, satisfying combat with simple controls.

[Heroes, Dragons, and Magic]
Recruit mighty heroes, including knights, warriors, priests, and mages. Their attacks come in many flavors: cold steel slashes, explosive magic runes, rapid-fire wand orbs – every strike is lethal! Discover ancient dragon eggs, hatch powerful dragons, and lead heroes and dragons into war together.

[Build, Trade, and Prosper]
Start with wheat, log, and iron, then turn raw materials into valuable goods through production and trade. Fulfill kingdom orders to earn gold and build your domain from a ruined village into a prosperous kingdom with your own hands.

[Real-Time Strategy, Full Control]
Command multiple troops in real time, combine different hero skills and unit types, and adapt your tactics on the battlefield. When the moment comes, unleash your dragon to shatter enemy defenses.

[Guild Warfare, Kingdom Conquest]
Create or join a powerful guild and fight alongside allies to capture castles, claim territory, and defeat rival forces. Use strategy, strength, and diplomacy to avenge your fallen kingdom and rule the continent!

data.name: โลกสวนดอกไม้ของฉัน
data.description_full:
เกมปลูกดอกไม้สุดฮิตที่ผู้เล่นทั่วโลกหลงรัก เตรียมเปิดให้บริการในไทยอย่างเป็นทางการวันที่ 3 มิถุนายน!
กิจกรรมเล่นเกมลุ้นรับดอกไม้จริงเปิดให้ร่วมสนุกได้ตลอด พร้อมจัดส่งตรงถึงบ้านสำหรับผู้เล่นในประเทศไทย!

โลกสวนดอกไม้ของฉันเป็นเกมจำลองสถานการณ์ที่ผ่อนคลายและเยียวยาจิตใจ ที่นี่คุณจะได้พบเพื่อนรักดอกไม้มากมาย และสร้างสังคมเพื่อนรักดอกไม้ของคุณเอง
เกมนี้เล่นง่าย เริ่มต้นได้ทันที ทุกครั้งที่ปลูกดอกไม้ก็มีความตื่นเต้นเล็กๆ รอคุณอยู่ เราอยากมอบความโรแมนติกจากโลกเสมือนมาสู่มือคุณจริงๆ!

〓 โชคดีมาแล้ว ‧ ดอกไม้สดส่งฟรีถึงบ้าน 〓
ความโรแมนติกสุดพิเศษสำหรับคุณ! เพียงปลูกดอกไม้ในเกม เมื่อเก็บเกี่ยวดอกไม้ที่โตเต็มที่ คุณมีโอกาสได้รับการ์ดอวยพรดอกไม้ และแลกเป็นช่อดอกไม้สดส่งตรงถึงบ้านฟรีเลย!

〓 ปลูกดอกไม้สบายๆ ‧ สร้างสวนเฉพาะของคุณ 〓
ในสวนเฉพาะของคุณ ปลูกดูแลกล้วยไม้ ลีลาวดี ดอกมะลิ และดอกไม้มากมายด้วยมือคุณเอง เพลิดเพลินกับช่วงเวลาการปลูกที่ผ่อนคลายและบำบัดใจ ปล่อยวางความเครียดทีละนิด พร้อมสัมผัสความอบอุ่นจากเพื่อนดอกไม้ที่อยู่เคียงข้าง

〓 สนุกกับเพื่อน ‧ คลายเครียดด้วยสังคมเกม 〓
ในสวนไม่มีคำว่าเหงา! ผูกมิตรกับเพื่อนซี้ เข้าร่วมกิลด์ เยี่ยมชมสวนเพื่อน หรือแม้แต่ "แอบขโมย" ดอกไม้จากเพื่อนได้ด้วย! สัมผัสประสบการณ์การเล่นที่สนุกสนานและผ่อนคลาย ทุกการพบเจอคือความประหลาดใจ

〓 ศิลปะการจัดดอกไม้ ‧ สร้างสรรค์ชีวิตมีระดับ 〓
ดอกไม้ที่เก็บเกี่ยวไม่ได้มีไว้ชมเท่านั้น แต่ยังจัดแต่งได้อย่างอิสระ ผสมผสานแจกันและดอกไม้หลากหลายชนิด สร้างสรรค์ผลงานจัดดอกไม้ของคุณเอง ตั้งแต่เลือกสีสันไปจนถึงสไตล์ ออกแบบสุนทรียภาพที่เป็นเอกลักษณ์เฉพาะตัว

〓 บริหารร้านดอกไม้ ‧ สัมผัสชีวิตเจ้าของร้าน 〓
รับออเดอร์ จัดทำ ขาย ขยายร้านดอกไม้ของคุณทีละขั้นตอน สร้างร้านดอกไม้ยอดนิยมของคุณอย่างค่อยเป็นค่อยไป ใช้กลยุทธ์การบริหารเพื่อเพิ่มรายได้ ให้สวนและร้านค้าเติบโตไปพร้อมกัน

〓 สัตว์เลี้ยงแสนน่ารัก ‧ เยียวยาใจเป็นสองเท่า 〓
ดูแลน้องแมวน่ารักในบ้านแมว ให้อาหาร ลูบไล้ ตกแต่งพื้นที่ส่วนตัว เพลิดเพลินกับช่วงเวลาแห่งความอบอุ่นที่มีเพื่อนซี้สี่ขาอยู่เคียงข้าง!

data.name: Arrows Cube 3D Glide
data.description_full:
Tap arrows to clear a real 3D cube - but here arrows wrap across the cube's edges onto neighbouring faces, so a path that looks blocked on one side may be open on another. Read all six sides, plan the order, watch the whole cube clear. 1000 hand-tuned levels, free, no in-app purchases.

This cross-face blocking is what sets Arrows Cube 3D Glide apart from flat 2D arrow and unblock puzzles - easy to learn, satisfying to master, and built to relax your mind while it stretches your spatial thinking.

HOW TO PLAY
- Tap an arrow to send it gliding off the cube in the direction it points.
- A blocked arrow can't move yet - find a free path first.
- Drag to orbit, flick to spin with momentum, pinch to zoom. One thumb is enough.
- Watch the edges: roughly one arrow in five crosses onto a neighbouring face, so plan around the whole cube, not a single side.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
- True 3D, not flat-in-3D: a cube you freely rotate, with cross-face arrows that wrap around the edges for real spatial planning no flat grid can match.
- 1000 hand-tuned levels - a real, finite campaign, not a random endless mill. Grids grow from a gentle 3x3 up to a dense 24x24 as your eye sharpens.
- Three difficulty tiers - Easy, Hard and Super Hard - so the challenge climbs with you.
- Challenging but fair: three lives means three different blocked arrows end a level, yet re-tapping the same red arrow is always free. Honest mistakes never cost you.
- No purchases, no paywalls. Free hints too - start with two, then earn another any time by choosing to watch a short ad. A hint highlights a safe move and swings the camera straight to it.
- Optional trajectory guides preview each arrow's flight path before you commit (off by default).
- Friendly cheer pop-ins that never interrupt play: a halfway nudge, a reward for a fast streak, and an eagle-eye nod when you spot the only free arrow on a crowded cube.
- Six color themes - Light, Gray, Charcoal, Black, Sand and Cream - plus independent Sound, Music and Vibration toggles to set your own calm.
- No accounts, no logins, no sign-up. Progress is saved locally on your device.
- Playable offline; the app uses the network only for ads and basic app services.

A calm, satisfying 3D brain teaser for fans of arrow, cube, escape and logic puzzles - and a fresh, true-3D take if you're tired of the same 2D unblock clones. No timer, no pressure, play at your own pace.

Can you read all six sides and clear every cube? 1000 levels are waiting.

Free to play, with ads. No in-app purchases.

data.name: Number Stitch
data.description_full:
Number Stitch is a relaxing ASMR game that blends number coloring with the warm art of weaving. Tap and drag across the grid to match the right areas – each fill instantly reveals a realistic stitch texture. Watch an empty hoop transform into a textured handmade piece. Whether you love coloring or just need a quiet way to unwind, this game delivers the simple joy of stitching something lovely with your own hands.
Gameplay Overview
Enter the level. As you drag, the selected area fills with color and texture immediately – release to complete the fill and stitch. Each numbered cell represents a target count. You must enclose exactly that many cells without overlapping already filled areas. Multiple hoop sections appear together, so you need to plan your fill order and layout to perfectly match all numbers. No timers, no penalties – just peaceful thinking and a soothing filling rhythm. Complete a hoop and your artwork is saved to your Collection Album to browse anytime. Daily challenges bring new patterns and goals, unlocking more stitch textures and themed sets.
Key Features
- Realistic Stitch Texture: Every fill isn't a flat color block but a clear woven texture. From fine flat stitches to plush yarn feels, each piece looks truly embroidered.
- Soothing ASMR Play: Drag, fill, release – every action comes with gentle sounds and subtle haptic feedback. The soft weaving sound as the thread covers the grid is deeply calming.
- Rich Content & Collection: Many hoop patterns await, from cute animals to beautiful landscapes. Completed works are automatically added to your Collection Album, building your own woven gallery. Daily challenges refresh often, unlocking more textures and themes.
- Strategic Layout, Easy to Learn: Simple tap and drag to fill, but as levels progress, multiple hoop sections interlock. You'll need clever planning of fill order and area distribution to perfectly complete each artwork.
Why You'll Love It
- Blends the fun of number coloring with the warm texture of weaving – both brain challenge and handmade therapy.
- No timers, no penalties – quiet filling and free retries, perfect for any relaxing moment.
- Fresh goals and little surprises every time you open – always something to brighten your day.
Ready to Stitch Your First Masterpiece?
Download Number Stitch. Tap, drag, fill, and weave – let every thread find its place. Enjoy the cozy ASMR sounds as you slowly embroider your own art album.

data.name: Merge Parade
data.description_full:
■ Build Your Army on a 5×5 Grid.

Merge Parade is a formation-based auto-battler set on a 5×5 grid. Buy monsters, merge them into stronger evolutions, and arrange them in a winning layout using powerful adjacency passives. Combat plays out automatically — your only job is deciding who stands where. One smart placement can turn the tide.

■ Core Gameplay Loop

- Buy monsters from the shop
- Place them on your 5×5 grid
- Merge neighboring units to evolve them
- Watch the auto-battle play out
- Use the gold you earn to build an even stronger army for the next fight

Battles end fast — about a minute at normal speed, just 20 seconds at top speed. Perfect for a quick session, addictive enough to lose hours in.

■ From a Tiny Slime to a Mighty Dragon

Goblins, slimes, plants, undead, demons, elementals, dragons, constructs, beasts — nine cute monster tribes to recruit and combine. Follow recipes to merge them, and watch small units evolve into towering powerhouses. Chain a few humble slimes all the way up to a colossal dragon lord and feel the army truly grow.

■ Formation Is Everything

Every unit comes with passives that depend on where you place it: "boost the attack of adjacent allies," "shine alone in a corner," "weaken nearby enemies," and many more. Columns also build up stacks of burn, slow, and shield as the fight unfolds. Push a stack high enough and a Surge erupts — a powerful burst that can flip the whole battle.

Stacking strong units isn't enough. Who stands next to whom, and which column they hold, decides the fight.

■ One Run, Fifteen Battles. Try Again, Try Smarter.

A roguelite structure with lives. Beat all 15 battles to clear a run. Lose a fight but keep your lives, and you can retry. Lose your last life, and the run ends.

Even a defeat teaches you something — new unit knowledge, new recipes discovered, new matchups understood. Every run sharpens your strategy for the next. Once you've conquered the basics, take on the tougher difficulty modes waiting for you. If you've got the skill, the challenge is ready.

■ A Small Goblin with Big Dreams

Meet Gobsby — a small-town goblin with grand ambitions. Beside him is Nick, a chatty little mimic-book, narrating his journey. With only a handful of monster friends at his side, Gobsby sets out for the distant Demon Lord's castle.

Recruit allies. Crush rivals. Watch your tiny gang grow into a marching army — a long, eccentric parade across the world. Cute, a little clumsy, but impossible not to root for. Their story is waiting for you to play it.

■ Perfect For Players Who Love

- Auto-battlers and idle-style action
- Puzzle-strategy and tactical placement
- Collecting, merging, and leveling up
- Quick sessions that fit any pocket of time
- Charming monster designs

■ Free to Play

* Optional in-app purchases / Contains ads

Take command. Set your formation. March your army to victory.

data.name: Cockroach Janta Play
data.description_full:
Cockroach Janta Play is an arcade survival game where you guide a
cockroach through 15 obstacle-based challenges on a journey to land
a job. Tap to flap, dodge the pipes, and survive each stage to reach
the final boss.

Gameplay

Flap your way through a side-scrolling world of pipes, ceilings, and
hazards. Each pipe you clear represents one real-life challenge on
the path to employment, such as traffic, exams, competition, and
interviews. Pass 15 stages to unlock the final boss level, where you
tap rapidly to attack and dodge incoming attacks.

Features

- Simple one-tap controls. Tap, click, or press space to flap.
- 15 obstacle-based stages with increasing difficulty.
- Four collectible power-ups: Skill, Shield, Support, and Awareness.
- A final boss stage with attack and dodge mechanics.
- Three difficulty modes: Easy, Regular, and Hard.
- Score tracking with a personal best record.
- Cartoon-style visuals and animations set in a night city.
- Offline gameplay. No internet connection required.

Controls

- Tap the screen, click, press space, or use the up arrow to flap.
- Avoid pipes, the ceiling, and the ground.
- Collect power-ups as you fly.
- In the boss stage, tap rapidly to attack and move to dodge.

How to Play

Choose your difficulty mode from the main menu, then tap to start
flapping. Time each flap carefully to fly between the gaps in the
pipes. Collect power-ups along the way to help you survive longer.
Pass all 15 stages to reach the final boss and complete the journey.

About the Game

Cockroach Janta Play combines arcade flap mechanics with a humorous
storyline about a determined cockroach working its way through
modern urban challenges. The game focuses on timing, reflexes, and
pattern recognition. It is designed for casual players who enjoy
short, replayable sessions.

data.name: Car Transport: Truck Simulator
data.description_full:
Haul luxury cars, SUVs, and sports vehicles across realistic city roads in Car Transport: Truck Simulator. Load cargo onto multi-car trailers, navigate traffic, and deliver every vehicle without a scratch. With realistic truck physics and smooth controls, this is the car transporter experience driving fans have been looking for.

You are a professional truck driver running a vehicle transport operation. Each mission puts you behind the wheel of a heavy-duty transporter truck, tasked with picking up cars from loading zones and delivering them to destinations across detailed city and highway environments. The cargo is valuable, the routes are challenging, and every delivery counts.

WHAT YOU GET IN EVERY SESSION

Realistic truck driving physics that make every turn, brake, and reversing maneuver feel authentic. This is not an arcade racer, it is a proper driving simulator built around weight, momentum, and vehicle handling.

Multi-car trailer loading where you drive cars onto the transporter deck yourself. Positioning matters, load angles matter, and one bad approach can damage cargo before you even leave the yard.

A full fleet of transport trucks and car trailers to unlock and upgrade. Start with a basic rig and work toward powerful heavy-duty haulers with larger trailers capable of carrying more vehicles per run.

Challenging delivery missions across varied environments including busy city streets, open highways, and tight urban loading zones. Traffic, sharp turns, and narrow passages test your truck driving skills at every level.

HD graphics with detailed vehicle models and environments. The cars on your trailer look like the luxury vehicles they are supposed to be, and the roads you drive feel lived-in and real.

Smooth, responsive controls built for mobile play. Whether you prefer tilt steering or on-screen buttons, the control layout is designed so new players can pick it up quickly while experienced sim drivers still feel the depth.

Progression that rewards consistent play. Complete delivery missions to earn in-game currency, then put that currency toward new trucks, upgraded trailers, and routes with higher difficulty and higher rewards.

WHY THIS SIMULATOR WORKS

Most truck driving games focus on long-haul highway runs. Car Transport: Truck Simulator focuses on the specific challenge of vehicle hauling, loading, maneuvering a fully loaded car carrier through city traffic, and delivering without damage. That focus makes every mission feel purposeful rather than repetitive.

If you enjoy vehicle transport games, heavy truck simulators, or car driving games that reward patience and precision over speed, this one is built for you.

Start your engine, load your trailer, and prove you have what it takes to run a professional car transport operation.

data.name: Dopamina Piano: Music Tiles
data.description_full:
Dopamina Piano is a music rhythm game where you tap falling tiles to the beat of real songs. Pop, kpop, EDM, hip-hop, classical — we've got a growing library with hundreds of tracks, and we add new ones every week.

The gameplay is simple: tiles fall, you tap. But keeping up at higher speeds? That's where it gets real. You'll start with easy songs and think "this is chill," then five minutes later you're sweating through a kpop track at 2x speed.

WHAT'S INSIDE

Songs for every taste
We cover a wide range — mainstream pop hits, kpop favorites, EDM bangers, chill classical piano pieces, and even trending tracks from TikTok and YouTube Shorts. New songs drop weekly so it doesn't get stale.

Actually fun game modes
Challenge Mode lets you compete for high scores on specific songs. Endless Mode keeps throwing tiles at you until you slip up. Normal Mode is there for when you just want to relax and tap at your own pace. And Rush Mode? That's for the people who think they're fast.

Play it anywhere
Works offline. No wifi, no data, no problem. We built it so you can play on the subway, on a plane, or just somewhere with bad signal. It's your piano game, play it wherever.

Free. For real.
No paywall to unlock songs. No "watch 10 ads to continue." Just download and start playing. That's it.

All skill levels
Your 8-year-old cousin can enjoy the easy songs. Your friend who plays rhythm games competitively can sweat through expert mode. Multiple difficulty levels mean nobody gets left out.

Smooth performance
We spent a lot of time making sure there's no input lag. When you tap, the tile responds instantly. Tested across a wide range of Android devices — budget phones included.

WHY PEOPLE STICK AROUND

Honestly, it's the "one more song" thing. You finish a track, see the next one in the list, and think "okay just one more." Before you know it, 40 minutes went by. The combination of rhythm, music, and the satisfaction of nailing a perfect run — it just works.

We also update regularly. New songs, seasonal events, and occasional new features. We actually read the reviews and try to build what players ask for.

Dopamina Piano: Music Tiles is free to download. Give it a shot — worst case, you'll find a new song you like. 🎵

data.name: Game Is Hard
data.description_full:
Game is Hard is not your typical puzzle app. This is a pure brain puzzle experience designed for players who love being challenged. With its clever, minimalist style and unexpected interactions, it blends elements of brain games, logic, and device-based exploration into a collection of brutally tricky levels and hard puzzle challenges, creating a unique hard puzzle game experience.

Every puzzle breaks the rules, no flashy animations, no rewards for guessing. Just you, your mind, and a seemingly simple task that might hide a brilliant, almost impossible solution. Whether you’re into strategy, trivia games, or iq test challenges, Game is Hard invites you to test your patience, perception, and persistence in a truly engaging hard puzzle game.

This is not about fast reflexes. It’s about slow, methodical progress. Some levels require silence. Others need movement. Many seem unsolvable, until they’re not. It’s a place for deep thinking and bold experimentation. Hints are available when needed, but progress is always earned.

If you've enjoyed titles like brain test games, logic puzzles, IQ tests, moron test or brain teaser games, and if you love dissecting a good tricky quest, this game is for you. It rewards those who think differently, the curious, the clever, the quietly stubborn.

With full support for offline games, you can play wherever and whenever you want, perfect for no wifi games, no internet games, or long travel sessions. Whether you're on airplane mode or deep underground, all puzzles remain playable.

And yes, it’s hard. In fact, some say it's difficult, others call it impossible. But every puzzle is built with purpose and can be solved with logic. Each hard level is designed to challenge your thinking in a unique way. If you're a fan of brain training, mind games, or just enjoy testing your limits, you'll find yourself right at home.

Each level is full of hidden ideas and clever mechanics waiting to be discovered. You'll experiment with sound, light, rotation, and pressure, even waiting. Solutions are not always obvious. But when you find them, the satisfaction is incredible, making it a memorable hard puzzle game experience.

Designed for fans of both classic and modern puzzle games, Game is Hard avoids the noise of the typical mobile fun games and focuses instead on clarity, challenge, and meaningful interaction. There’s no time pressure. No ads. No noise. Just deep puzzles that respect your intelligence.
Whether you see yourself as a genius, an impulse problem-solver, or simply someone who enjoys a good brainly test, this game invites you to try. And try again. And maybe finally succeed.

Features:
• Handcrafted brain puzzle levels with clever, logical solutions
• Challenging hard puzzle mechanics and unique level design
• Hints are available, but never obvious
• Works fully offline, great for no wifi games and free play
• Minimalist, flat design with zero distractions
• Touch, motion, and sound-based mechanics
• Built for players who enjoy hard, clever, and unusual challenges
• No scores or timers, just pure gameplay

data.name: Gun Girls: Mist Survival
data.description_full:
Gun Girls: Mist Survival is an intense tactical shooter SLG game set in a modern warzone overrun by the undead. Recruit and command elite female snipers, each with unique combat specialties and backstories, to form your ultimate kill squad. Experience precision shooting with intuitive controls, dynamic battlefield effects, and devastating sniper skills.

Humanity stands on the brink.
The Mist came first — a creeping, unnatural fog that brought the dead back to life. Then came the hordes. Relentless. Hungry. Without mercy.
No one knows the true origin. Cities burned. Modern armies, with all their tanks, drones, and missiles, were swallowed by the endless tide of flesh and rot.
There was no holding the line.
The survivors scattered, hiding in bunkers, ruins, and shadowed corners of a shattered world.
And then, a whisper became a hope: marksmen who could end a threat from a mile away. Precision over power. One bullet, one kill.
But ordinary shooters weren’t enough. They needed weapons that could think. Girls born from elite military programs, enhanced with next-gen targeting systems and forged in the crucible of total war.

Now, years after the fall, a new signal cuts through the static.
A covert watchtower network has been revived. Inside, cryo-chambers hiss open.
They are the Gun Girls — sniper operatives, each a master of long-range death, coded with the tactical knowledge of humanity’s finest soldiers.
They climb to the surface, rifle in hand, the weight of a dead world on their shoulders.
The Mist is thick. The dead are many. But a single, perfect shot can still change everything.
They are humanity’s last bullet.


Standout Snipers with Distinctive Personalities
Deadly, alluring, and unforgettable.
Watch your sniper squadron come to life in battle — from stealth takedowns to explosive kill shots. Play now.

Stunning Modern-Warfare Visuals
Cutting-edge character animation and physics-based rifle handling.
Dynamic scope glint, bullet trails, and environmental destruction.
Experience sniper combat like never before.

Tactical Precision Combat
Use unique rifle abilities, stealth positioning, and ultimate Burst Shots to eliminate swarming undead and rogue human factions.
Master wind, distance, and timing in a fresh, innovative battle system.

A Bleak Post-Apocalyptic Story
Unravel the mystery of the Mist and the fall of civilization.
Every shot tells a story. Every survivor has a past. Fight through a world of loss, fear, and cold revenge.

data.name: Arrow Pro 3D
data.description_full:
Welcome to Arrow Pro 3D, a relaxing and engaging 3D puzzle experience where observation, timing, and planning come together.
Rotate the cube, release arrows, and clear surfaces gradually. Careful observation and thoughtful decisions help create smooth clearing sequences and solve spatial challenges that gradually become more complex.
The controls are simple to understand, while puzzle layouts continue to encourage deeper thinking as progress continues.

- A fully rotatable 3D puzzle environment
Arrow Pro 3D takes place on an interactive three-dimensional cube. Unlike flat puzzle designs, every face contributes to the overall solution. At times, the answer may be located on the opposite side, requiring rotation and observation from different angles.
Players can rotate the cube freely, zoom in to inspect details, and study each surface before choosing the next move. This freedom allows exploration and supports thoughtful planning throughout each level.

- Release arrows and clear surfaces
The core mechanic focuses on releasing arrows in the correct order. Tap an arrow to activate it, and they will travel forward along its direction, removing other arrows encountered along the path.
Some arrows travel short distances, while others move across larger areas. Understanding how arrows interact allows multiple elements to be removed efficiently. Careful sequencing often creates satisfying chain reactions that clear large sections of the cube.

- Hundreds of handcrafted puzzles
Arrow Pro 3D contains a wide collection of handcrafted puzzles designed to maintain interest over time. Early challenges introduce fundamental behavior and basic movement patterns. As progress continues, layouts expand and require stronger observation and structured planning.
Players will encounter:
- Beginner-friendly compact cube layouts
- Medium difficulty spatial arrangements
- Large cube structures requiring careful reasoning
- Multi-stage solutions that reward planning and patience
Each layout presents a different arrangement that supports flexible thinking and encourages experimentation.

- Smooth and relaxing interactions
The overall experience focuses on steady pacing and visual clarity. Arrows glide across cube surfaces in a fluid motion. As elements disappear gradually, the cube becomes less crowded, creating a consistent visual rhythm.
A minimalist visual approach keeps attention on puzzle solving while maintaining readability during longer play sessions. Subtle animations provide visual feedback without distraction.

- Develop thinking skills naturally
Arrow Pro 3D offers a structured way to exercise reasoning skills while maintaining a calm environment.
Regular play supports:
- Spatial awareness
- Logical reasoning
- Planning ability
- Pattern recognition
- Problem-solving confidence
Players may spend time studying layouts carefully or proceed quickly through simpler puzzles. Each session supports observation and structured thinking.

- Designed for flexible play sessions
Whether there are only a few minutes available or a longer period of time, Arrow Pro 3D adapts comfortably to different schedules.Short puzzle layouts fit brief moments of play. Larger structures support longer sessions that encourage focused attention.
Suitable moments to play include:
- During short breaks
- While traveling
- Before rest
- During quiet moments
The structure supports gradual progression while maintaining a balanced level of challenge. Early puzzles provide clear learning opportunities, while later layouts require deeper reasoning and patience. Completing a puzzle often feels similar to solving a small mechanical structure.

data.name: Piggy Escape
data.description_full:
🐷 Screw Rescue — Match Two, Set Piggy Free! 🐷

Poor little piggy is trapped behind metal plates. Each plate is held in place by two screws. Your mission? Remove every screw and let the pig run free!

🎨 Match the Colors
Tap two screws of the same color, and they disappear together. Get the colors right, and the plates start falling apart. Get it wrong? Those screws stay stuck.

📦 5 Slots for Screws
Under the plates, there are 5 storage slots. When you tap a screw, it moves down into an empty slot, waiting for its matching partner. But if all 5 slots fill up with mismatched screws… you’re stuck. You’ll need to plan carefully and clear pairs before the slots overflow.

🧠 Trickier Every Level
At first, it’s simple — a few plates, clear colors. But as you progress, more colors appear, and the metal plates twist into crazy shapes. Some screws hide behind others. You’ll need sharp eyes and quick thinking to keep the slots from jamming.

⏱️ Race to Save the Pig
No timer, but you can compete with friends — who can rescue the piggy the fastest?

Ready to pull those screws and free the squealing hero? Start matching and save the pig! 🐽🔴🔵🟡🟢💥

data.name: Project Racer
data.description_full:
[Every human racer makes mistakes, but It doesn’t - AlphaRacer B.R.G srl ]

Project: Racer is a realistic racing game on mobile that features a unique online career mode with realistic driving physics where the driver need to work along with the team to pursuit the ultimate goal of racing driver and to race the championship with other real players from all over the world. The game is developed under very close supervision of professionals from real life racing and racing enthusiasts from game industry.



[REALISTIC HANDLING]

Project:Racer doesn’t compromise the realistic physics to adapt mobile platform, you will have to brake early and make the corner without an unrealistically fast speed, and you will find the grass being bumpy and slippery like an ice-patch in some cases. If you go off the track, even if it’s still on tarmac, the grip level would drop drastically because the track surface off the racing line could be very dirty.



[START YOUR ONLINE RACING CAREER]

After signing up with a manufacture team, the new racing season starts from the freezing winter test. With the assist from team engineers, you will set up the car from the basic configurations like seat positions and gear ratio, to some advance adjustments like wheel alignment, tire pressure, or even the throttle response.



[DEVELOPING THE CAR THROUGH THE SEASON]

The tension builds up as the season progresses. Every team is upgrading their chassis and engine. You are the only one who will be on track to give direct feedback for the engineers to improve the chassis and engine. Every minute on the track, every second in the corner and every championship point separates winning and losing.



[THE MANUFACTURE AND TEAM BATTLES]

4 Engine suppliers and 10 manufacture teams spread the battle from the race track to the factory, but a small team is still possible to beat an international manufacture.

As the weather and the grip level are dynamic in Project:Racer, experiences will be the key to make a racing car faster, team budget will not be the only factor.



[ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE RACING ERA]

In the parallel universe of Project:Racer, an ambitious project was introduced and promoted by BRG srl - a global Motorsport company owned by Jam Bristol. Will the Racing Robot “AlphaRacer” finally replace human drivers in the near future? The answer will be revealed based on choice of all the online racers...



When your eyes are hidden behind the silver visor, the world outside is muted and you are the one racing against time.

data.name: Obby Keyboard ASMR Runner
data.description_full:
⌨️ Run Across a Giant Keyboard


Obby Keyboard ASMR Runner turns a typing board into a fast little world of jumps, taps, and close calls. Your obby hero starts on a huge keyboard track where each key can become a step, a trap, a ramp, or the next chance to run ahead. Feel the ASMR rhythm of key taps while you race through a bright obstacle course built for quick reflexes, satisfying movement, and one more clean run.



🏃 Keep the Run Moving


Each run pushes you to read the path, dodge traps, climb over blockers, and keep speed before the next challenge appears. A safe key can turn into a launch pad, a narrow lane can become a balance test, and a boss blocker can force a new route. The controls stay simple, but every obstacle asks for sharper timing, better focus, and a faster reaction when the course changes.



⚡ Level Up and Run Faster


Collect progress, level up, and upgrade your runner so every keyboard race feels stronger than the last. More speed means bigger jumps, faster reactions, and better chances to escape tricky traps. The more you play, the more your obby runner feels ready for harder parkour moments, taller climbs, faster runs, and tighter gaps between moving keys.



🏁 Race Other Players


This is not just a solo keyboard run. Chase rivals through the track, fight for better places, and use every speed boost to pass the pack. A multiplayer race can change in seconds: one clean jump, one missed trap, one brave climb, and your obby can move from the back to the front. Stay focused, watch the lanes, and keep the race alive until the finish.



🧱 Traps, Bosses, and Moving Keys


The keyboard course keeps fighting back. Traps slide into your lane, bosses block the way, and moving keys make every run feel new. Some levels test precision controls, while others focus on pure speed. Learn the pattern, time the jump, climb past the danger, and turn each obstacle into a clean escape. When the boss appears, stay calm, find the opening, and push your runner through.



🎧 ASMR Key Tap Feeling


The keyboard theme is made for satisfying taps, clicky keys, and smooth ASMR moments. Every step across the QWERTY path can feel crisp, quick, and tactile, like a tiny typing ASMR challenge turned into a runner. Run over key taps, chase the thock of a mechanical board, and enjoy a race that feels as good as it looks, especially when a clean streak carries you past the next trap.



🌟 Why Players Love It



  • Fast obby action across a giant keyboard world

  • ASMR key taps, clicky keys, and satisfying movement

  • Level up, upgrade speed, and run faster every round

  • Traps, bosses, climbs, and obstacle course challenges

  • Multiplayer race energy with rivals to beat

  • Short, fun runs that are kid-friendly and easy to start



🚀 Become the Keyboard Obby Runner


Ready for a faster keyboard challenge? Start your next run, climb past the traps, beat the bosses, and race through every obstacle with better speed and cleaner timing. Level up your obby, master the keys, improve your precision controls, and become the runner everyone is trying to catch.
