We guarantee: Solitaria will put your brain & your lexical skills to the test! 🧠 It’s a true breath of fresh air for experienced word puzzle players.

How to play Solitaria:

• scan the open cards and find words that can be combined into a semantic cluster;
• collect all related terms in one stack, starting with the golden category card;
• clear bottom cards to access those lying above — just like in classic solitaire;
• if there is nothing left to group on the board, draw cards from the deck and repeat the arranging process with new words and images;
• keep in mind that only terms and images with a common theme can be combined;
• try to save moves and empty card slots, cause if you run out of space, you'll get stuck;
• when there are no moves left or the attempt limit is reached, use hints or restart the level;
• if you manage to correctly link all associations and no cards remain on the field — congratulations, you’ve won!

Why you’ll love Solitaria:

📖 Regular updates of linguistic categories.

In Solitaria, you will sort various words and illustrations, organizing cards according to solitaire rules. Our ad-free puzzle is not only interesting but also educational! 🎓 The constant search for correct connections sharpens your focus, and concentrating on details helps calm the mind. The gameplay is both exciting & relaxing.

Your convenience is our top priority, so no wifi is needed to play! 🔥 Solitaria is an excellent option for trips, cause it’s fully compatible with airplane mode. data.name: Tile Hole Master
data.description_full:
Tile Hole Master is a structured tile puzzle where you control a moving hole to swallow tiles and clear the board. Each level presents a carefully arranged tile layout that requires precise movement, smart positioning, and strategic board clearing.
In Tile Hole Master, the goal is simple: move the hole across the board and collect all tiles. However, each tile puzzle introduces different formations, stacked tile clusters, compact tile grids, and layered tile layouts that change how you approach the board. You must plan your path to avoid blocking future movement while clearing every tile.
Core Tile Hole Gameplay
• Drag to move the hole freely across the board
• Swallow tiles by positioning the hole correctly
• Clear all tiles to complete the level
• Avoid bombs and blocked zones
• Use boosters to manage dense tile formations
• Progress through increasingly structured tile boards
The tile hole mechanic focuses on movement precision and spatial awareness. Because tiles are arranged in structured formations, clearing one area too quickly may limit access to other tile groups. Careful path planning becomes essential as tile layouts grow more complex.

Tile Puzzle Design
Tile Hole Master is built around tile collection and board clearing strategy. Each tile puzzle level introduces different board shapes and tile arrangements. Some boards feature compact tile stacks. Others include layered tile blocks that require gradual clearing.
The puzzle design emphasizes tile grouping and tile flow. Understanding how tiles connect and how the hole moves across the surface is key to solving each stage. Tile collect strategy becomes more important as levels increase in density and obstacle placement.

Themed Tile Collections
Throughout progression, the tile visuals evolve into themed tile worlds while maintaining the same tile hole mechanic. The themes change the appearance of the tiles but preserve the structured tile puzzle gameplay.
Each theme introduces a fresh tile environment while keeping the tile collect and board clear objective consistent. The themed tiles create visual variety without changing the core hole puzzle structure.

Mahjong-Style Tile Layouts
Some levels feature mahjong-style tile layouts, inspired by structured tile stacks and patterned tile formations. These mahjong-style tile boards focus on arrangement awareness and board clearing order.
While Tile Hole Master is not a traditional mahjong match game, the visual tile structures may resemble mahjong tile stacks. The gameplay remains centered on moving the hole, swallowing tiles, and clearing the board.
Obstacles and Boosters: As tile boards become denser, additional elements appear:
Boosters help manage complex tile formations by supporting tile clearing in crowded areas. Strategic use of boosters can assist in finishing structured tile layouts.

Strategic Board Clearing
Tile Hole Master focuses on:
• Tile movement strategy
• Board awareness
• Spatial puzzle solving
• Tile grouping efficiency
• Structured board clearing
Each tile hole puzzle requires analyzing the tile layout before making large movements. Efficient tile collection prevents the hole from getting trapped by remaining tile blocks.

3D Tile Interaction
The 3D environment enhances tile depth and tile stacking visibility. You move the hole around elevated tile blocks, dense tile clusters, and layered tile formations. This adds dimension to the tile puzzle experience while preserving the core tile collect mechanic.

Tile Hole Master combines:
tile hole gameplay, tile puzzle structure, tile collect strategy, 3D tile boards, mahjong-style layouts, and evolving tile themes.
Every level centers on tile clearing, controlled movement, and structured puzzle design. Progress through themed tile worlds, refine your tile strategy, and clear each board by mastering the tile hole mechanic.

Terms Of Use: https://pineapplegames.net/terms.html

data.name: Word Puzzle
data.description_full:
Welcome to Cozy Paws Paradise, a gentle, heart-soothing match-3 puzzle game wrapped in the softest 2D cartoon art style you’ve ever seen. This is not just another matching game — it’s a peaceful little world where adorable animals live, play, recover, and grow together, and you become their kind helper with every gentle tap and match.
Imagine waking up to golden sunlight filtering through fluffy clouds, pastel meadows dotted with daisies, tiny wooden bridges over sparkling brooks, and everywhere you look — big round eyes, twitching noses, floofy tails, and the softest fur imaginable. Foxes in tiny scarves, bunnies wearing flower crowns, sleepy hedgehogs curled in teacups, curious red pandas holding bamboo smoothies, and even a chubby manatee wearing a straw hat floating in a lily pond… Every character is hand-drawn with love, warm colors, and that unmistakable cozy “aaahhh” feeling.
Story & Atmosphere — A World That Needs Your Gentle Touch
Long ago, the magical land of Pawsbury was a joyful haven where animals of all kinds lived in perfect harmony. But one day, a gentle but mysterious “Gloom Mist” drifted in from the edges of the map. It didn’t bring danger or villains — it simply made everything feel a little heavy, a little lonely, a little tired. Flowers lost their shine, rivers became sluggish, trees drooped, and many animals started feeling small sadnesses they couldn’t explain.
That’s when you, the kind-hearted Wanderer, arrived with an empty basket and an open heart. The animals quickly realized your special gift: when you match three or more of the same glowing fruits, flowers, shells, stars or acorns, the matching energy turns into warm light particles that gently push the Gloom Mist away and bring back color, sound, and smiles.
Every level you complete isn’t just a “win” — it’s an act of healing.

Match strawberries → the little bunny with a bandaged ear can finally hop again
Match blueberries → the shy fawn stops hiding behind the tree
Match glowing fireflies → the night-blind owl can see the stars once more
Match warm cinnamon buns → the cold penguin gets a cozy scarf knitted by grandma sheep

No rush. No pressure. No scary bosses. Just you, the animals, and thousands of tiny moments of “everything is going to be okay.”
Core Gameplay — Relaxing Yet Satisfying Match-3
At its heart, Cozy Paws Paradise keeps the classic match-3 formula you love, but removes all the stress and adds layers of cozy comfort:

No lives / No energy bar — play as long as your heart desires (or until your phone battery asks for mercy)
Very forgiving design — no hard time limits on most levels; gentle “relax mode” available
Cute boosters born from friendship — instead of generic bombs, you get:
→ “Hug Blast” from bear hugs
→ “Paw Print Line” from kitty dashes
→ “Rainbow Acorn Shower” from squirrel thank-yous
→ “Sleepy Moon Beam” from collective yawns of sleepy sloths
Chain & combo system feels like petting — long chains create soothing chimes, sparkles, and animals doing happy little dances
Over 1200+ handcrafted levels launching, with new story chapters added every 3–4 weeks

Healing & Progression — Watch the World Bloom
As you play, the central Cozy Meadow hub world visibly transforms:

Week 1: The meadow is soft but a bit gray; only a few animals are awake
Week 50: Flowers everywhere, picnic tables set, lanterns glowing, animals holding tiny parties
Week 200: Secret grove unlocks with cherry blossom rain, firefly concerts, and a giant group cuddle pile under the stars

Warriors from the FINAL FANTASY (FF) series assemble in modern-day Tokyo to save the world from destruction in DISSIDIA DUELLUM FINAL FANTASY.

Fight in 3-versus-3 battles where two teams fight monsters and clash in a race to defeat the powerful boss faster than the enemy team!

Acquire various abilities and unleash them in battle to gain the upper hand.
Customize your loadout from an array of abilities, including numerous newly drawn illustrations by a stellar team of artists.

■ EASY-TO-LEARN CONTROLS
Play with simple controls anywhere and on-the-go!
Change the control scheme to one that suits you best from various control settings.

Explore a new DISSIDIA story unfolding in modern-day Tokyo with FINAL FANTASY warriors brought to life with full Japanese voice acting and beautiful cel-shaded graphics. Get a glimpse into their daily lives and interactions with one another by watching chat messenger episodes.

Show off your style by outfitting FINAL FANTASY characters in their original looks or new clothes fit to roam around the modern world!
Collect original and arranged music tracks from your favorite FF games, edit your profile, chat with other players, and join the ultimate FINAL FANTASY community!

data.name: Imposter Game: Who is the Spy?
data.description_full:
Listen closely and decide together - WHO IS THE IMPOSTER?

The Imposter game is built around one simple mechanic: most players know the secret word, and one does not. In every round of this imposter party word game, each person gives an association. One player must fake it and try to blend in.

The group talks, debates, and tries to find the impostor before it’s too late. Someone may confidently guess the imposter, while others wait and analyze who is the spy.


HOW TO PLAY
- See the word — or fake it if you didn’t.
- Give a clue.
- Discuss who is suspicious.
- Vote to find the impostor.

This imposter party word game is a hidden liar game, where subtle lying and careful listening decide the outcome. Players constantly try to find out who is lying, then they may challenge each other to explain their hints. When the discussion peaks, everyone will vote to guess the imposter.
In every imposter game, you must observe reactions and help the group find the impostor. Sometimes you immediately know who is the imposter; other times you hesitate, wondering who is lying while someone tries to fake it again!


Social deduction made simple: read people, think fast, and have fun!
Inspired by familiar unmask the spy game formats, this gameplay focuses on conversation and deduction—read behavior, control the situation and find who is the spy, or stay undercover and don't reveal yourself while guessing!

Listen carefully, analyze hints, and unmask the secret role. Each round challenges you to uncover the truth, even when someone stays completely under cover. Soon the room fills with questions: who imposter was acting strange? Who is lying about their clue? And finally — Who is the imposter?

PERFECT FOR GROUPS
It’s a simple game to play with friends! This flexible party game belongs in every collection of fun games to play with friends—it works as a quick group game during gatherings, trips or night parties. It fits naturally, it's easy to start, and matches other classic fun party games.
You can launch an imposter game anywhere and begin an imposter party word game session in seconds. Whether you’re hosting a casual party game night or organizing spontaneous fun games to play with friends, the format keeps everyone involved.

Play again and fake it better. Listen closer. And find the impostor! In every imposter game, someone must stay undercover, others will guess the imposter, and then must decide who is the spy.
data.description_short: Find the impostor undercover! Play with friends and guess who is the spy

data.name: Exile: Wasteland Survival PRO
data.description_full:
Exile is an addictive survival RPG in a wild wasteland where your main goal is to stay alive. Wilderness of the desert spares no one. In this primitive open world, only the strongest survive.

The story tells of how the Great Ancient Civilization, which reached the peak of its development & could not stay on it. This action adventure games includes not only a survival simulator, but also an exciting multiplayer RPG open world. Global warming turn the whole world into a wasteland entailed the irreparable loss of the former great heritage of the Ancients. You are one of the few who were able to survive the natural disaster. The world has rolled back from an advanced civilization to a primitive era, where the preservation of a bonfire comes first in the rules of survival games. In this role-playing game online you will be able to play the role of Conan the warrior, who will have to craft, build and fight so that the next day does not become the last on this earth.

1. CRAFT AND BUILD TO SURVIVE
Base building is one of the important parts of the open world survival games. The survivor needs craft skills, to build a base that will withstand the adversity of dangerous enemies & animals. Craft weapons and armor to hack and slash enemies in the wasteland and defend your base.

2. CREATE YOUR OWN SURVIVOR
In this survival RPG you can create your own Conan warrior. The role-playing game mode will allow you to customize your survivor down to the smallest detail, starting from hair color and finishing choices of magic ancient patterns on the body. Give your desert warrior a rare name & start your action adventure RPG in the cruel fantasy open world.

3. EXPLORE WASTELAND LOCATIONS
The wasteland is fraught with many dangers. Desert survival simulator 3d will confront the survivor with terrible enemies: formidable tribal giants, terrify scorpions, predatory hyenas & terrify tigers. There is always a choice, either to hack and slash down enemies to the last, or to escape, the main goal is to survive and delay the last day on earth as far as possible.

4. RULES OF SURVIVAL GAMES
Exile is a survival simulator close to reality, where a warrior can be killed not only by enemies, but also by hunger, thirst or natural disasters. But if you adhere to the basic rules of survival, then your Conan warrior will be able to survive for a long time in the open world RPG of the wilderness. Always keep an eye on the bonfire; in a primitive world you cannot survive without it. Improve your crafting skills, base building and battles, they will help you in the action adventure games online.

Exile is a wasteland survival RPG with an open world and multiplayer. A realistic survival simulator that will immerse you in the desert adventure of the primitive fantasy world.

Contact email: help@pgstudio.io
Follow our Facebook page to share your experience in survival games: https://www.facebook.com/exilesurvival

data.name: Granny Escape Horror 3D
data.description_full:
Can you outwit Granny and escape her haunted house — or will you become her next victim? Trapped inside a dark, decaying mansion, you have just 5 days to solve puzzles, find hidden escape routes, and stay completely silent. One creak of the floorboard, one knocked-over object… and she's already on her way.

SCARY GRANNY HORROR GAME 3D puts you inside a fully rendered 3D horror environment where stealth, observation, and nerve are your only tools. Whether you sneak through shadows alone or challenge a friend in multiplayer horror gameplay, every run through Granny's house is a fresh fight for survival.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WHAT YOU'LL FACE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔦 A Living, Breathing Horror House
Every room in this escape house hides secrets — locked doors, hidden objects, and dark corners where Granny could be waiting. The haunted house layout changes the way you think about every step you take.

👂 Sound-Driven AI That Punishes Noise
Granny doesn't rely on sight alone. She tracks sound. Drop something, run across a squeaky floor, or slam a door — and the scary grandma will come. Realistic 3D audio makes you feel every threat before you see it.

🔐 Multi-Layer Puzzle Escape System
This isn't a simple grandma escape room. Cracking your way out requires finding and combining items, decoding clues, and unlocking a chain of exits — each one harder than the last. Five distinct escape routes mean no two playthroughs are identical.

👥 Multiplayer Horror Mode
Team up or go head-to-head in multiplayer horror game sessions. Coordinate with a partner to distract the scary grandma while the other solves puzzles — or compete to see who survives longest inside the granny house. Multiplayer horror games with a grandma antagonist hit differently when the threat is this relentless.

🧠 Strategic Hiding Mechanics
Slide under beds. Press into closets. Hold your breath while Granny's footsteps pass inches away. The horror survival tension isn't just in the jump scares — it's in the seconds of silence before she decides to move on.

🎮 Controls Built for Tension, Not Frustration
Intuitive movement and interaction controls keep the focus on the fear, not the interface. New players can learn in minutes; surviving more than a day or two takes genuine skill and strategy.

📈 Progressive Difficulty
Each day inside the scary granny house tightens the screws. Granny moves faster, searches more thoroughly, and leaves fewer safe hiding spots. Reach day 5 and you'll understand why so few players ever walk out the front door.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WHO THIS GAME IS FOR
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

If you've played granny escape games and want deeper puzzle mechanics, a scarier atmosphere, and the option to bring a friend into the nightmare — Scary Granny Horror Game 3D delivers that experience in full 3D horror.

Fans of escape room horror, stealth survival, and multiplayer horror games will find a granny house that genuinely unsettles.

⚠️ Recommended for players who enjoy psychological tension, horror audio design, and puzzle-driven survival. Play with headphones for the full effect — preferably not alone at night.

Install now. Granny is already listening.

Experience the thrill of Omi4, Sri Lanka’s beloved traditional card game, now on your mobile device! Whether you’re a seasoned player or new to the game, Omi App brings the full traditional experience to life with smooth gameplay, vibrant graphics, and multiplayer action.

Key Features:
1. Onboarding & User Management
Multi-Language Support
Interactive Tutorial


2. Core Gameplay Modes
Single Player
Quick Play
Multiplayer
Play with Friends


3. Multiplayer Infrastructure
Friends Lobby
Matchmaking
Connection Handling


4. In-Game Mechanics & UI
Trump Card Selection
Dynamic Pop-Ups
Last Round Review
Card & Board Skins


5. Economy & Customization
My Wallet
In-App Shop
Leaderboard
Settings

How to Play Omi4:
Objective:
Win the highest number of tricks each round to earn tokens and
secure victory.

Dealing Cards:
Omi4 uses a 32-card deck (from the standard 52-card pack).
Each player receives two batches of four cards, totaling eight
cards per player.

Choosing the Trump Suit:
The player to the dealer’s right selects the trump suit,
which outranks all other suits for that round.

Leading the First Trick:
The player who chose the trump suit leads the first trick.
Other players must follow suit if possible; otherwise,
they may play any card.

Winning Tricks:
The highest card of the suit led wins the trick unless a trump
card is played. If a trump is played, the highest trump wins.
The trick winner leads the next round.

Counting Tricks & Tokens:
5–7 tricks with the trump suit: 1 token for the trump
team. 5–7 tricks without the trump suit: 2 tokens
for the other team.
Winning all 8 tricks: 3 tokens (“Kapothi”).
If both teams win 4 tricks each, no tokens transfer;
the next winning team earns an extra token.

Winning the Game:
The first team to reach 10 tokens or more wins the game
and becomes the ultimate Sinhala Omi champion!

BALL x PIT is a brick-breaking, ball-fusing, base-building survival roguelite. Batter hordes of enemies with ricocheting balls and gather the riches of the pit to expand your homestead, generate resources and recruit unique heroes.

BALL x PIT is a fast-paced fantasy roguelite where heroes must find the balls to plunge deeper into a seemingly bottomless pit of monsters. Develop arcane ammunition and resources in pursuit of treasure, recruiting additional heroes to aid you in your perilous quest.

Ballbylon has fallen. After a meteoric and completely unexpected event annihilated the great city, all that remains is an ominous, yawning pit. Treasure hunters from far and wide flock to the city’s tomb to seek their fortune, plumbing the depths in search of Ballbylon’s scattered riches. Few return.

The pit plays host to armies of barbaric creatures, hellbent on ending your quest before it even begins. Armed with a growing arsenal of magic-infused projectiles, batter your way through multiple levels of increasingly challenging obstacles to claim the ultimate prizes and rebuild New Ballbylon.

Fuse Your Balls
The Ball Fusion system encourages explosive experimentation with over 60 randomized balls to equip and combine during your journey. Discover overpowered combinations and unexpected synergies from hundreds of possible outcomes.

Build New Ballbylon
Expand New Ballbylon with over 70 unique buildings that provide gameplay bonuses and unlock further power-ups, new characters, and more! As your community grows, task homebound heroes with automated tasks to keep the resources coming while you dive deeper into the pit.

Discover New Realms
Face legions of diverse enemies within the pit, battling through barren deserts, frozen caverns, savage forests and more. Each region offers its own unique set of hazards on top of hordes of increasingly challenging foes and mighty, screen-filling bosses.

Recruit Fellow Hunters
As you explore the pit you’ll encounter fellow treasure hunters eager to add their skills to your expedition. Each character has unique, upgradable mechanics that totally change the way you play the game. Experimentation and adaptation are crucial to the success of New Ballbylon!

data.name: Obelisk: Home Horror Game
data.description_full:
Obelisk: Home Horror Game is an analog horror game and survival horror game inspired by The Obelisk Analog Horror. Enter a distorted home where fear feels personal, the walls feel alive, and every room pulls you deeper into a nightmare shaped by VHS horror, psychological terror, and maze-like dread.

This is not just another scary house. This is home, your hallway, your bedroom door, your familiar rooms twisted into a living trap by analog horror logic. Lights buzz like a dying CRT. Audio bends into a low mechanical hum. Static tears across the screen. The house changes when you are not looking, and somewhere inside it, The Obelisk is watching.

In The Obelisk: Home Horror Game, the core nightmare is simple: escape a place that refuses to let you leave. Rooms connect the wrong way. Corridors loop back with something subtly changed. Doors open into spaces that should not exist. A staircase leads farther down than your house should ever allow. What begins as a familiar environment becomes a cruel, shifting prison of fear.

Fans of The Obelisk Analog Horror, creepypasta horror, VHS horror, and psychological horror games will recognize the oppressive dread of stories like House with No Windows, Why Do You Keep Us Here, The Man in the Tower, and I Made a New Friend. This game turns that feeling into an interactive nightmare where the horror is intimate, distorted, and always close.

This is survival horror without power fantasy. You cannot become a hero. You cannot overpower what hunts you. You cannot fight The Obelisk. Your only tools are observation, timing, silence, and instinct. Listen for movement that does not match your own. Watch for details that shift. Learn the house before it learns you.

If you love analog horror games, scary games, VHS horror aesthetics, and dark exploration inside a cursed house, The Obelisk: Home Horror Game delivers a tense and immersive descent into fear. The deeper you go, the less your home feels like home, and the more it feels like something built to keep you inside forever.

You cannot reason with the house.
You cannot fight The Obelisk.
You can only survive long enough to understand what it wants.

And if you are wrong, the house will keep you.

The Obelisk: Home Horror Game is a terrifying analog horror experience for players who want survival horror, VHS horror, and a nightmare built from familiar spaces turned hostile.

data.name: Titan Rush
data.description_full:
Волны поглотили цивилизацию, а Идзю разорвали наши дома. Мир повергнут в безмолвие, надежда покоится на дне океана. Выжившие, добро пожаловать в последнюю гавань — подводную базу. Это место ветхое, но безопасное; бедное, но полное жизни. Восстанавливайте оборудование, запускайте энергию, создавайте фермы. В этом подводном убежище из стали и воды мы вновь зажжём искру человечества. А в самой глубине базы дремлет гигантский мех, жаждущий пробуждения. Он станет клинком, что вернёт человечество на землю, и последним стражем в апокалипсисе.

[Перестройка базы: От выживания к возрождению]
Используйте каждое пространство, перезапустите каждое оборудование. От наладки базового энергоконтура до создания устойчивой подводной фермы, от расширения жилого квартала до запуска оружейного цеха — каждый шаг в строительстве решает вопрос жизни и смерти. Грамотное планирование схемы базы, разработка технологий апокалипсиса, усиление ресурсооборота — создание в морской бездне самодостаточной крепости.

[Восстановление меха: Глубинный клинок, рождённый для битвы]
Восстановите спящего гиганта и откройте комплексную систему вооружений — высокоэнергетические торпеды, импульсные орудия, глубинные резаки... Свободно комбинируйте оснащения под задачи боя и раскрывайте весь потенциал меха в реальных сражениях. Шквальным огнём сокрушайте стаи Идзю, а повышая манёвренность и ЗАЩ — готовьтесь к нашествию гигантских Идзю!

[Сбор командиров: Женская элита в строю]
В апокалипсисе они пришли на выручку со всех сторон. Логист, виртуозно управляющий ресурсами, Тактик, мастер внезапных рейдов, Инженер, специализирующийся на усилении мехов... Каждый командир привносит уникальные усиления для базы и меха. Грамотно комбинируя их таланты, создайте элитный отряд — живучий и могущественный. Вместе проложите путь сквозь бездну и руины к новому будущему.

[Исследуйте руины: Глубины таят, цивилизацию ищут]
Бывший город покоится под тёмными течениями, но в нём сокрыты и сокровища апокалипсиса. Сформируйте экспедиционный отряд и проникните в опасный город-руины. В поисках утраченных энергоядер, дефицитного снабжения, исчезнувших технологий... Каждое исследование может принести урожай, способный изменить всё, но грозит внезапной атакой глубоководных Идзю. Здесь риск и награда неразделимы.

[Альянс единства: Мы идём плечом к плечу]
Один в поле не воин. Бездне нужен отклик. Вступайте в альянс или создайте свой, чтобы совместно с другими выжившими делиться технологиями, обмениваться ресурсами и вести скоординированную оборону. Участвуйте в заданиях альянса, противостойте волнам гигантских Идзю и боритесь за стратегические глубинные зоны. Здесь ты не одинок во тьме. Вместе мы станем самой прочной линией обороны человечества в бездне.

>>Скачайте сейчас! Вернитесь на последнюю базу человечества<<

data.name: 巡夢少女
data.description_full:
夢是心的鏡子，而我是擦鏡的人。
踏入朱門雕欄，聽簷角風鈴輕響，似有前朝舊夢低語，這裏是權謀與浪漫交織的舞臺。在這裏你將化身「心醫」，以治癒之力解開這宮牆之下人們的心結，從高傲的公主到陰鬱的王子，他們的命運因你而改變。
但宮廷的帷幕下，隱藏著更深的秘密。隨著你的治癒之旅深入，一個關於存亡、橫跨現實與夢境的巨大陰謀逐漸浮出水面……
夢境的褶皺裏究竟藏著多少現實的傷痕？請記住，當夢境開始坍塌，愛是唯一解答……
誠邀各位入夢人，共赴這場古風綺麗、浪漫療愈的巡夢之旅，探尋人心深處的秘密，書寫屬於你的治癒傳奇。

遊戲特色：
=◇入夢尋心：探秘綺麗幻境◇=
夢境之中，表像皆為虛妄，唯有“執念”是真相的線索。晝是權謀的戲臺，夜是夢魘的畫卷。身居高位者，亦有不可觸及的脆弱與隱秘。你的能力，便是潛入這些破碎的夢境，化解深藏的悲痛與執念。你將在夢境中穿梭，與夢境主人一同面對記憶的潮汐，修復靈魂的裂痕。每一次入夢，都是一場視覺與心靈的雙重探險，窺盡眾生百態，浮世悲歡。

=◇天命相牽：良緣命定相遇◇=
緣起夢境，情定今生。每一次的相遇皆是命中註定，巡夢的故事中你將邂逅數位性格迥異、背景神秘的命定之人：是溫潤如玉的院判，還是喜怒無常的暴君？是灑脫不羈的將軍，還是深藏不露的國師？在夢境與現實的交織點，你與他們並肩作戰，互相取暖。每一次心防的卸下，每一次真情的流露，都是一場雙向的救贖。

=◇綾羅羽裳：千般風情隨心◇=
衣裝不僅是身份的象徵，更是心境的表達。你的“巡夢少女”形象將由你親手雕琢。我們為你準備了一個包羅萬象、極盡奢華的夢幻衣櫥：從飄逸出塵的仙氣古裝，到華麗繁複的洛可哥宮廷禮服，再到神秘魅惑的異域風情，綾羅羽裳，目不暇接，只待你以匠心裁剪，織就夢中霓裳。

=◇羈絆誓言：並肩風雪同舟◇=
寒夜共暖，逆境相扶，在這座看似繁華卻孤獨的紅牆內，你以“心醫”之名，行救贖之事。你將在此邂逅的，不僅是求醫問藥的過客，更是命中註定與你並肩的同路人，是熠熠夢河中與你星軌交錯的繁星，是一群在命運洪流中掙扎、卻依然選擇堅守信念的靈魂，我們描繪的，是一幅關於信任、勇氣與愛的群像畫卷。

Nâng cấp các công trình sản xuất để quy trình vận hành trơn tru hơn. Sử dụng điện năng để vận hành khu trú ẩn hiệu quả hơn. Mở khóa và nâng cấp thêm nhiều công trình để đáp ứng các nhu cầu ngày càng tăng.

Khám phá xa hơn và phát hiện các tài nguyên độc đáo trong những quần xã sinh vật khác nhau. Thu thập và tận dụng mọi tài nguyên để giành lợi thế.

data.name: Aqua Twist - Color Flow Puzzle
data.description_full:
Looking for a cozy way to unwind and pass the time? Welcome to Aqua Twist - Color Flow Puzzle, your new favorite way to chill out.

If you love a good color water sort or sorting puzzle, you're going to feel right at home here. We designed this game to be the perfect little escape for your brain—whether you're waiting in line, boring on the subway, lounging on the couch, or just winding down before bed.

🌊 Why you'll love playing Aqua Twist:
- Ultimate ASMR Vibes: There is something deeply satisfying about watching the liquids flow and mix. The gentle, ASMR-style pouring is incredibly relaxing and the absolute best way to kill some free time.

- Easy on the Eyes: We know bright screens can be a lot, so we picked gorgeous, soothing color palettes. The visuals are super nice for your eyes, meaning you can play comfortably for as long as you want.

- Gentle Brain Training: While the vibe is totally relaxed, figuring out the right logic to sort the water is actually a fantastic, low-stress workout for your brain. It keeps your mind sharp without making you sweat!

- Zero Pressure (No Timers!): Take a deep breath. There are absolutely no ticking clocks here. You can take all the time you need to plan your moves and just enjoy the process at your own pace.

- Fun Challenges & Unique Tubes: As you progress, you'll discover totally unique tubes, beautifully shaped flasks, and fun challenge levels that keep things fresh without ever feeling frustrating.

💧 How to play:
- Tap any tube to pick it up, then tap another to pour the water.

- Match the colors! You can only pour water if the top color of both tubes matches and there’s enough room.

- Sort it out: Keep pouring until each tube holds just one solid color. You win!

- Got stuck? No worries at all. You can easily undo a move or add an extra empty tube whenever you need a little help.

Ready to relax and get your flow on? Download Aqua Twist - Color Flow Puzzle today and treat your brain to a well-deserved break!

data.name: Башни и Герои: Война Миров
data.description_full:
«Башни и Герои: Война Миров» — Искусство башенной обороны, где ваша тактика решает всё!

Ядро игры: бесконечно разнообразная стратегия обороны
Каждая локация — это холст для вашего тактического гения. Огромное количество уникальных карт, от извилистых троп до сложных лабиринтов, от открытых полей до неприступных ущелий — каждая битва ставит новую стратегическую задачу. Классический геймплей башенной защиты выведен на новый уровень: типы башен, комбинации навыков, пути улучшений и распределение ресурсов — каждое ваше решение меняет ход сражения. Испытайте свои пределы в режиме «Испытание Бездны», где бесконечные волны врагов проверят вашу оборону на прочность.

Соревновательный PvP: битва умов на вершине
Искусство обороны — это не только защита, но и интеллектуальное противостояние с сильнейшими! От «Полигона Тактики», где проверяются основы, до «Небесного Рейтинга» для элиты и легендарной межсерверной лиги «Война Святилищ» — здесь создана целая экосистема для истинных стратегов. Покажите свой уникальный стиль защиты, изучите тактики лучших игроков мира и станьте мастером башенной обороны в битве стратегий.

Герои и оборона: стройте идеальную защитную систему
Герои — это не просто воины, а ключевые элементы вашей обороны! Легендарные герои открывают эксклюзивные навыки для башен, эпические герои дают уникальные усиления. Получите легендарного командира обороны при входе в игру, открывайте редких мастеров-строителей, проходя уровни. Система синергии между героями и башнями меняет правила игры: маг огня усиливает огненные башни, паладин даёт щиты, ассасин усиливает ловушки. Создайте свою непобедимую комбинацию!

Умный прогресс: наслаждайтесь сутью тактики
Мы вернулись к истокам жанра — радость стратегии не должна тонуть в рутине. Уникальная система офлайн-развития позволяет вашей обороне совершенствоваться постоянно. Никакого монотонного гринда и обязательных входов в игру. Каждая ваша сессия — это новые тактические вызовы. Ваше время посвящено только оптимизации построек, изучению тактик и соревновательным боям — чистому и глубокому искусству башенной обороны.

«Башни и Герои: Война Миров» — Здесь нет места простому накоплению силы, только продуманным построениям. Здесь нет побед через превосходство в статистиках, только через интеллектуальное превосходство. Присоединяйтесь и станьте архитектором победы!

DAY — SHAWARMA KIOSK

By day, you are just a simple worker in a small shawarma kiosk.
You cook tasty shawarma, take orders, keep the place clean, throw out the trash, and try to grow your tiny business.
It’s a normal workday — just like millions of other workers live every day.

Many customers pass through your kiosk.
Some of them feel too strange, others are openly unsettling.
Someone stares for too long. Someone says inappropriate things.
Some customers come back again and again, smiling in a way that feels wrong.
What if they’re not even human?

But you endure it.
That’s work.
You need patience.
Nothing scary… right?

NIGHT — HORROR AND INSOMNIA

When the kiosk closes, a completely different game begins.

At night, the work simulator turns into true domestic psychological horror.
You can’t sleep. Strange sounds echo through your apartment. Shadows move.
Unsettling visions follow you from room to room.

You keep doing everyday things — cooking food, cleaning, trying to relax —

data.name: Minicraft: Craftarena Block 3D
data.description_full:
Minicraft - Block Craftarena is a highly popular sandbox game that immerses players in an expansive, pixelated world filled with creativity, exploration, and survival. Here's a breakdown of its key features:

1. Endless Exploration:
Minicraft Block Craftarena 3D offers a vast block 3D OpenWorld gameplay, procedurally generated world to discover. From lush forests and towering mountain ranges to expansive oceans and deep caves, there’s no shortage of new areas to explore.

2. Boundless Creativity:
With its signature block-based building system, players have the freedom to create anything from complex structures and stunning landscapes to functional redstone devices, all limited only by their imagination.

3. Creative Mode:
For those who prefer an unrestricted experience, Creative mode provides infinite resources and the ability to fly, letting players build grand creations without worrying about resource gathering or dangerous mobs.

4. Mining and Crafting:
The heart of the gameplay revolves around mining resources like ores and minerals to craft useful items, tools, and weapons. The crafting system is straightforward, allowing players to combine items in a crafting grid.

5. Redstone Engineering:
Redstone, a special resource, allows players to design complex machinery, circuits, and automated systems. From simple traps to elaborate devices, redstone engineering introduces a technical side to the game.

6. Survival Mode:
In Survival mode, players must gather resources, craft essential tools, and defend themselves from hostile mobs. The changing day and night cycles introduce new challenges, with nighttime bringing more dangerous enemies.

7. Multiplayer Features:
Craftarena’s multiplayer mode enables players to collaborate or compete with friends and other players. Whether building together or engaging in player-versus-player combat, it adds a social and competitive element to the game.

8. Enchanting and Brewing:
As players advance, they can enchant weapons and tools to give them special abilities, or brew potions to improve their survival. These deeper mechanics add long-term goals and variety to gameplay.

9. Biomes and Dimensions:
The game world is divided into several biomes, each with unique climates, vegetation, and terrain. Players can also venture into mystical dimensions like the Nether and the End, where they’ll face new challenges and reap rich rewards.

10. Mobs and Creatures:
Craftarena’s world is filled with a range of creatures, from the infamous Creeper to Endermen and more. Each mob introduces unique challenges, requiring players to adjust their strategies and tactics to survive.

In summary, the allure of Minicraft Block Craftarena 3D lies in its combination of open-ended creativity, survival challenges, exploration, and a thriving multiplayer community. Whether you're playing solo or with friends, the possibilities in this vast, blocky world are truly endless.
data.description_short: Minicraft Pro version, build, survive & explore in Craft's Block World.

data.name: Ninja Hunt: Stealth Assassin

Ninja Hunt uses the quiet of stealth and the sharpness of shooting to sketch a shadowy vision of a ninja hunter. Whether you are a strategy focused player or a shooting fan who seeks thrilling kills, here you will find your own hunting excitement. Join now, begin an endless journey through the shadows, and let bows, crossbows and ninjutsu blaze with brilliance on the battlefield!

data.name: Tile Clear - Puzzle Game
data.description_full:
Looking for a clean, pure tile-matching game with zero distractions? Welcome to Tile Clear, a straightforward triple match puzzle where the goal is simple: match 3 identical tiles, clear the stack, and finish the level.

No stories. No themes. No complicated extras. Just the classic, satisfying gameplay you love—refined into a smooth, relaxing experience you can play anytime.

Simple Rules, Real Challenge
Tile Clear is easy to learn: tap a tile, place it into the tray, and match three of the same to clear them. Sounds simple—until the board gets crowded and every move matters. Planning ahead and managing space is the key to victory.

Why You’ll Love Tile Clear
Pure Triple Match Gameplay: Every level is focused on stacking and matching—nothing else.
Quick to Learn, Hard to Master: Perfect for beginners, satisfying for puzzle pros.
Relaxing Yet Engaging: Calm pacing with a rewarding “clear” feeling in every match.
Smooth, Tap-Friendly Controls: Play comfortably with one hand, anywhere.
Plenty of Levels: Enjoy a steady flow of puzzles designed to keep your brain active.
Play Your Way
Whether you want a short break, a relaxing nightly routine, or a puzzle challenge to sharpen your focus, Tile Clear fits right in. Take your time, think ahead, and enjoy that perfect moment when the last tiles disappear.

Download Tile Clear now and enjoy triple matching in its purest form—tap, match, clear, repeat.

data.name: Dragon Rescue: Save the Girl
data.description_full:
Are you ready to step into the boots of a legendary hero? Welcome to a world where your strategy saves the day! A giant mythical dragon has captured the princess, and it is up to you to break its heavy defenses, defeat the fierce beast, and lead a successful rescue mission to bring her home safely.

The core gameplay is casual, fun, and designed to test your logical thinking. On each level, you will see a massive creature blocking the path, while a unique stack of colorful 3D blocks sits on your screen. Your ultimate goal is to clear these blocks strategically to launch powerful cannon attacks against the enemy, making it a perfect evaluation of your reflexes.

To win the battle, you must look closely at the changing colors of the beast's body to find its current vulnerability. Tapping and removing the corresponding colored blocks from your screen instantly triggers your turrets to fire an elemental shot. Your main task is to fully deplete the monster's health bar before it reaches the end of the path. Once the creature is eliminated, the princess is finally safe, and you win the challenge!

However, victory requires careful preparation and precise timing. One wrong move or random tapping without a clear plan will cause your matching slots to fill up completely, allowing the dragon to overcome your defenses. Think fast, act precisely, and experience the immense satisfaction of watching the giant enemy crumble piece by piece as you solve the challenge.

As you progress further into this magical journey, the difficulty increases to keep your brain sharp. You will travel through diverse and beautifully designed environments, ranging from freezing glaciers to scorching deserts, each offering a fresh visual style. New obstacles are waiting to be uncovered, including locked blocks, hidden traps, and massive boss battles that require your best tactical choices.

This experience offers simple, intuitive tap controls with zero learning curve, making it ideal for anyone looking to relax their mind while enjoying a thrilling adventure story. Face the ultimate test of judgment, defeat the beast, and bring the princess home safely!

data.description_full:
『今生は恋より茶に生きる』は、合成 × 経営 × 古風ストーリーが調和した、心安らぐ没入型ゲームです。
小さな茶楼から始め、合成の工夫と丁寧な経営で店を発展させ、仲間との出会いや隠された謎を解き明かしながら、女主人公の逆転物語を紡いでいきます。

「魅力的な物語 × 深まる絆」
重生したあなたは茶楼の主人として、新たな姿で過去の因縁と向き合います。物語は友情や家族、寄り添い合う温かな関係を中心に描かれます。旅の途中では、侠客、商人、茶道名士など個性豊かな人物と出会い、専用エピソードやサブストーリーが開放。長く封じられた謎にも踏み込む、奥深い物語体験が待っています。

「合成で創る × 経営で育てる」
合成の心地よいテンポを存分に楽しめます。
食材を合成して特製茶点を開発し、家具や建材を合成して茶楼を強化。注文をこなし評判を上げ、日々の経営方針を工夫しながら、少しずつ新エリアやストーリーを解放していきます。

「古風の世界観 × 自由な装飾」
唐宋の雰囲気を繊細に描いた美しい中国風アート。
にぎやかな街角や雨音に包まれた情景など、音と色が古代の空気を優しく再現します。数千種の料理や多数の家具を自由に組み合わせ、あなただけの理想の茶楼を作り上げられます。

「茶の文化 × 受け継がれる知恵」
NPCとの会話では茶の知識や奥義を学び、クエストを通して茶香家の伝統に触れられます。茶文化と合成ゲームプレイが調和し、雅やかな物語が広がります。

物語が好きな方も、装飾が好きな方も、癒しを求める方も。
『今生は恋より茶に生きる』は、あなたを穏やかな旅へと誘います。
